The Project Engineer – Steam Turbine & Generator serves as the primary technical liaison between Mitsubishi Power engineering, project management, EPC contractors, equipment suppliers, and customers during project execution. This role is responsible for coordinating engineering, scheduling, procurement, and technical activities to ensure steam turbine, generator, and auxiliary system scope is delivered in accordance with contractual requirements, project schedules, and quality standards. Working in a multidisciplinary project environment, the Project Engineer facilitates communication, resolves technical issues, and supports successful execution of power generation projects from engineering through commissioning and warranty support.

Key Responsibilities
  • Demonstrates our core competencies: Action oriented, change champion, customer-focused, developing self & others, and ownership
  • Lead resolution of technical issues involving steam turbines, generators, and associated systems among EPC contractors, Owner’s Engineers, customers, and Mitsubishi Power during project execution.
  • Develop and maintain engineering execution strategies and Division of Responsibility (DOR) guidelines with turbine and generator affiliates to ensure clear ownership and efficient project delivery.
  • Capture, document, and share lessons learned from project execution to support continuous improvement across the organization.
  • Review and interpret technical documentation, including P&IDs, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), equipment layouts, specifications, and engineering drawings.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities, resolving interface issues between Mitsubishi Power engineering teams and steam turbine/generator suppliers.
  • Translate contract requirements and scope of work into actionable engineering deliverables and support alignment across discipline engineering teams.
  • Conduct and participate in meetings with international engineering partners to support successful project implementation and issue resolution.
  • Review and approve project documents and drawings to ensure compliance with contractual requirements and document control processes.
  • Collaborate closely with gas turbine, project engineering, sourcing, quality, and project management teams to support project execution, vendor coordination, and customer requirements.
  • Maintain working knowledge of applicable engineering codes and standards, including ASME, ANSI, AWS, API, ASTM, NFPA, IEEE, and NEC, as they relate to steam turbines, generators, and auxiliary equipment.
  • Support Application Engineering in evaluating customer specifications and technical requirements in conjunction with affiliate engineering organizations.
  • Track and resolve open technical issues through project completion and warranty expiration, ensuring timely closure and customer satisfaction.
Requirements

  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with experience working effectively with customers, EPC contractors, suppliers, and international project teams.
  • Knowledge of construction, commissioning, and project delivery processes for large-scale industrial or power generation facilities.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and ethical business practices, including experience working within OSHA and ISO-compliant environments.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and engineering/project management tools; experience with SP3D is preferred.
  • Professional certifications, such as Professional Engineer (P.E.) licensure and/or Project Management Professional (PMP), are preferred.
  • International business experience and fluency in Japanese and/or Spanish are highly desirable.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed to support project execution, customer meetings, and site activities.

title: AM2 Assessor
description:
AM2 Assessor

37 Hours per Week | Permanent | All Year Round
You know what a competent electrician looks like. Help us protect the standard.

About this job

AM2 means something in the electrical industry.

It’s where candidates demonstrate that they can take the knowledge and skills they’ve developed and apply them independently, safely and to the standard expected of a competent electrician.

We’re looking for an experienced electrician to join our licensed AM2 Assessment Centre at Pagefield and help us maintain that standard.

This isn’t a teaching role. You won’t coach candidates through their assessment or tell them what to do next. Instead, you’ll observe what they actually do, apply the assessment criteria fairly and consistently and make sound professional judgements about whether the required standard has been demonstrated.

For someone with substantial electrical industry experience, it’s a different way to use your expertise while continuing to play an important role in the profession.
  • Deliver independent AM2-series assessments in line with NET requirements.
  • Observe candidates undertaking practical electrical activities.
  • Assess installation, safe isolation, inspection and testing, fault diagnosis and rectification where required.
  • Make objective, evidence-based assessment decisions.
  • Record assessment activity accurately using NET’s systems.
  • Maintain clear and auditable assessment evidence.
  • Monitor safe working and intervene where there is an unacceptable risk.
  • Keep assessment bays, equipment and resources ready for use.
  • Take part in NET standardisation, quality assurance and audit activity.
  • Maintain your technical knowledge, occupational competence and required approvals.
  • Protect the boundary between independent assessment and training.
  • Significant practical experience as an electrician.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical installation, inspection and testing, safe isolation and fault diagnosis.
  • A current ECS Gold Card as an Installation Electrician with the required underpinning qualifications.
  • A current BS 7671 qualification.
  • An appropriate Level 3 Inspection and Testing qualification.
  • A First Aid at Work qualification or the ability to achieve this before your first independent assessment.
  • An assessor award or certificate, or the ability to achieve one within NET’s required timescale.
  • Confidence making objective judgements against defined standards.
  • Good digital skills and the ability to maintain detailed assessment records.
  • Previous AM2 assessment experience would be an advantage, but isn’t essential if you meet NET’s eligibility requirements.
What you’re like
  • Fair and consistent. You assess what the candidate actually demonstrates.
  • Calm and approachable. You create a professional environment without crossing into coaching.
  • Precise. You notice the detail and understand why consistency matters.
  • Confident. You can make and stand behind professional assessment decisions.
  • Safety-focused. You recognise unsafe practice and act when needed.
  • Independent. You understand that protecting the credibility of the assessment is part of the job.
Essentials
  • You’ll need to meet NET’s current eligibility requirements and successfully complete their approval and registration process before independently carrying out AM2 assessments.
  • You’ll also need to meet our safer recruitment requirements, including an enhanced DBS check and other relevant pre-employment checks.
At Wigan & Leigh College, technical education sits at the heart of what we do.
Our licensed AM2 Assessment Centre at Pagefield supports candidates to demonstrate the occupational competence recognised by the electrical industry.

You’ll work in a specialist technical environment where your industry expertise matters. You’ll help maintain consistent assessment standards, support a professional candidate experience and protect the credibility of an assessment that carries real weight in the sector.

title: Construction Technician - Commercial Refrigeration
description:
Climate Pros is building talent pipelines to meet future hiring demands; we want to build relationships with prospective candidates like you. If your background is a match to our requirements, we'll follow up with an exploratory conversation.

Note: The location for this potential opportunity is with the Western United States. Particularly in the states of CA, AZ, NV, and WA.

The Construction Technician – Commercial Refrigeration performs journeyman-level construction, installation, and modification work on commercial refrigeration and HVAC/R systems in accordance with collective bargaining agreements, industry standards, and applicable codes. Work is performed on new construction, renovations, and system retrofits in commercial and industrial environments.

This position requires technical proficiency, safe work practices, and adherence to union work rules while supporting high-quality project execution and customer satisfaction.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, modify, and commission commercial refrigeration and HVAC/R systems using construction drawings, blueprints, specifications, and project documents
  • Perform skilled pipefitting, brazing, welding, electrical, and mechanical work related to refrigeration construction projects
  • Install and connect:
    • Compressors, condensers, evaporators, pumps, heat exchangers, and refrigeration rack systems
    • Pneumatic, electronic, and electric control valves
    • Refrigerant piping, line sets, air distribution systems, and ductwork
  • Pressure test, evacuate, and leak-test piping and joints using electronic detection equipment, gauges, or approved test methods in compliance with code and manufacturer standards
  • Perform electrical testing and verification of circuits, components, sensors, and controls related to refrigeration systems
  • Inspect completed installations to ensure compliance with project scope, safety standards, union agreements, and regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate work activities with forepersons, project managers, other trades, and inspectors to ensure efficient project progression
  • Maintain professional interaction with customers, general contractors, and jobsite personnel while representing the company and union
  • Accurately complete required job documentation, time entry, and check-in/check-out procedures per company and union standards
  • Participate in after-hours, emergency, or on-call rotations as defined by operational needs and collective bargaining agreements

Union, Safety, and Compliance Responsibilities

  • Work in full compliance with:
    • Collective bargaining agreements
    • OSHA and applicable federal, state, and local safety regulations
    • Environmental and refrigerant-handling requirements
  • Maintain required licenses, certifications, and union training credentials (e.g., EPA 608, OSHA, safety certifications)
  • Demonstrate consistent use of required PPE and safe work practices on all jobsites

Qualifications & Skills

  • Completion of a recognized union apprenticeship program or possession of journeyman status in refrigeration, pipefitting, HVAC/R, or a related trade
  • Proven experience in commercial refrigeration construction environments
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, specifications, and control drawings
  • Working knowledge of refrigeration systems, controls, piping practices, and startup procedures
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills related to installed systems
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work within a team-based, union construction environment

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Regularly required to stand, walk, bend, climb, kneel, stoop, and work in confined or elevated spaces
  • Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 75 lbs
  • Ability to work in varying weather conditions, jobsite environments, and noise levels
  • Potential exposure to refrigerants, chemicals, and jobsite hazards consistent with commercial construction work

Additional Notes

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Duties and responsibilities may change in accordance with operational needs, collective bargaining agreements, or business requirements. The employer provides equal employment opportunities in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

In alignment with Climate Pros’ values and applicable laws, we are committed to promoting pay transparency and equity. Compensation within the stated range will vary based on the candidate’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Final offers will be tailored to the individual’s qualifications and potential contribution.

title: Sr. Collections Specialist
description:
Innovative Chemical Products Group (ICP Group) is a leading formulator and manufacturer of specialty coatings, adhesives, and sealants serving the building and construction end markets. Founded in 2015 by a private equity firm, ICP Group has scaled rapidly through organic and acquisition growth into one of the largest coatings, adhesives, and sealants companies in North America providing products which encompass the “building envelope” from roof to flooring and outdoor spaces. ICP Group is headquartered in Andover, MA and Tampa, FL and has manufacturing and distribution sites in the US, Canada, the UK, Australia and Japan.

ICP Group is seeking a proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven Senior Collections Specialist to support and optimize the Company's collections and credit functions across North American operations. This role is responsible for driving cash collections, reducing aged receivables, evaluating customer creditworthiness, and managing customer deductions, rebates, credits, and disputes.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in business-to-business collections, customer account management, credit analysis, and dispute resolution. This individual will take ownership of assigned collection activities, work directly with customers to secure payment, assess and monitor credit risk, and partner with internal teams to resolve issues impacting timely payment. Success in this role requires strong negotiation skills, sound judgment, excellent customer service, and the ability to balance collections effectiveness with maintaining positive customer relationships.

The Senior Collections Specialist will serve as a key partner to Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and Accounting teams while acting as a subject matter expert in collections and credit management best practices.

This position is based in Tampa, FL – Hybrid schedule, 3 days in the office, 2 days remote. The pay is between $28-30/hour

Responsibilities:
Credit & Collections Management
  • Manage daily collection activities and drive efforts to improve cash flow and reduce past-due accounts.
  • Personally manage key and high-risk customer accounts, conducting collection calls, sending correspondence, and negotiating payment resolutions.
  • Execute collection strategies based on account aging, payment trends, dispute activity, and customer risk profiles.
  • Review customer payment behavior and proactively identify collection risks.
  • Escalate delinquent accounts and recommend appropriate actions, including credit holds, payment plans, or third-party collections.
  • Maintain productive customer relationships while ensuring accountability for timely payment.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase collection effectiveness and operational efficiency.
Credit Management & Risk Assessment
  • Evaluate new customer credit applications and recommend appropriate credit limits and payment terms.
  • Conduct ongoing reviews of customer creditworthiness using financial information, payment history, trade references, and credit reporting tools.
  • Monitor customer accounts for signs of deteriorating credit risk and communicate recommendations for changes to credit exposure.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to balance business growth objectives with prudent credit risk management.
  • Support adherence to company credit policies and procedures.
Customer Deductions, Rebates & Credits
  • Manage customer deductions, rebates, credits, chargebacks, and pricing claims to ensure timely review and resolution.
  • Investigate disputed invoices and payment shortfalls by coordinating with Sales, Customer Service, and Accounting.
  • Reconcile rebate programs, promotional allowances, and customer credits to ensure accuracy and compliance with company policies.
  • Ensure all deductions and credits are properly documented and resolved promptly.
  • Identify recurring causes of disputes and deductions and recommend corrective actions.
Accounts Receivable & Customer Account Management
  • Review aging reports and prioritize collection activities to maximize cash recovery.
  • Monitor account balances and resolve payment discrepancies impacting collections.
  • Partner with internal teams to address invoice, billing, pricing, shipping, or documentation issues that delay payment.
  • Support the resolution of unapplied cash and customer payment discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate customer account records, collection notes, and supporting documentation.
Reporting & Process Improvement
  • Track and report on collections metrics, including aging performance, past-due balances, dispute resolution, and collection effectiveness.
  • Analyze collection trends and recommend actions to improve cash flow and reduce risk exposure.
  • Maintain accurate records related to customer credit limits, collection activities, and account status.
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Assist with training and mentoring less experienced team members as needed.

Experience Needed
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in credit and collections, commercial collections, or accounts receivable.
  • Proven experience conducting high-volume B2B collections and customer account management.
  • Strong experience evaluating customer creditworthiness, establishing credit recommendations, and managing credit risk.
  • Experience negotiating payment plans and resolving delinquent accounts.
  • Experience managing customer deductions, rebates, chargebacks, credits, and dispute resolution.
  • Experience in a manufacturing, distribution, or industrial environment preferred.
  • Working knowledge of ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, and credit reporting tools.
  • Strong understanding of commercial credit practices, collection techniques, and aging analysis.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and customer relationship management skills.
  • Ability to influence customers and internal stakeholders to drive timely resolution of payment issues.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional certification such as CBA, CBF, or similar credit-related designation is a plus.

ICP Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic data, or religion or other legally protected status.

title: Systems Development Engineer II, US Amazon Dedicated Cloud Security Engineering
description:
AWS Security is looking for a driven professional to join its high-security systems engineering team to manage the operation of our physical access control system (PACS), as well as help us automate a sustainable and robust architecture for future growth.

As an SysDev, you will be responsible for the overall health and security of our critical service, providing excellent customer service to our partners in a classified environment.

Engineers on this team play an integral role in the future of physical security. You will own the integration with enterprise and commodity hardware through proprietary and open source protocols, build extensible management tooling by which customers are delighted, produce infrastructure as code and robust operational monitoring that scales with our growing infrastructure. You will make sure the entire deployment process is performant, automated, and well tested to keep development iteration fast and unhindered by unnecessary operational misses.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and operate the physical access control system (PACS), ensuring its overall health, availability, and security
- Build integrations with enterprise and commodity hardware through proprietary and open source protocols
- Develop extensible management tooling and custom APIs for security system integration
- Build automation frameworks for infrastructure as code (IaC) deployment and configuration management
- Create monitoring and alerting systems to track service health and detect anomalies
- Implement secure communication and authentication between distributed systems
- Write high-quality, maintainable code and perform peer code reviews
- Partner with internal customers to understand operational challenges and deliver solutions

A day in the life
You'll spend your day operating and improving the physical access control systems that secure our classified environments. Expect hands-on coding, peer code reviews, and diving into distributed systems to improve reliability, scalability, and security. You'll build infrastructure as code, integrate enterprise and commodity hardware, and develop monitoring and alerting to keep the PACS healthy. You'll automate routine operational work so the team stays fast and agile, and partner directly with internal customers to understand their challenges and deliver practical solutions in a classified environment.

About the team
The AWS US ADC Security Engineering team builds and operates the high-security systems that protect our classified environments, including the physical access control systems (PACS) at the heart of this role. We work in a fast-paced, multi-disciplinary environment, collaborating with other AWS teams to deliver reliable, secure services for our customers, and we care deeply about security, customer experience, and operational excellence.

Amazon Security values diverse experiences, so even if you don't meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. We value work-life harmony and offer flexible arrangements, ongoing learning, and real opportunities for career growth.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Senior II Security Incident Responder
description:
Do you enjoy cyber security and taking ownership to get the job done?

Are you excited about working with cutting-edge security systems?

Join our Infosec team focused on Threat and Vulnerability Management

InfoSec TVM Team is responsible for safeguarding the security of Akamai's systems, infrastructure and providing internal advocacy for security practices. Opportunity to work closely with product and platform teams throughout the company.

Are you a Security Subject Matter Expert

As a Senior II Security Incident Responder, responsibilities include investigating security incidents, analyzing digital evidence, collaborating with teams, and preventing threats. You will gain exposure to some of the complex tasks within the job function. The role requires technical competence, familiarity with recent threats, and adversarial techniques.

As a Senior II Security Incident Responder, you will be responsible for:

  • Conducting in-depth investigations of security incidents, such as data breaches, malware infections, unauthorized access attempts and more.
  • Identifying the root cause of security incidents and determining the scope of the impact.
  • Using the central alerting and graphing systems to monitor internal infrastructure and customer events
  • Collaborating with various security teams to address threats, enhance defenses, and prevent future incidents by improving overall security posture.
  • Overseeing the identification and resolution of vulnerabilities arising from security-related incidents with precision and efficiency.
  • Providing training and offering guidance to team members regarding security incidents, potential gaps, and associated risks effectively.
  • Staying current with emerging threat hunts and digital forensics tools and methodologies ensures expertise and effectiveness in the field.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • 12 years of experience in Information Security and a High School Diploma or a Bachelor's Degree in a related field
  • 6-8 years specifically focused on Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR), intrusion detection, and network or application security
  • Understand traditional Endpoint, Network, Perimeter, and Endpoint Detection Response security product solutions, including tools like SentinelOne or CrowdStrike.
  • Have solid knowledge of operating system internals (macOS, Linux, and/or Windows) and network fundamentals
  • Show proficiency in using forensic tools such as Sleuthkit, Axiom, Magnet, EnCase, FTK, Autopsy, and other industry-standard software
  • Bring Relevant certifications such as CHFI, CISSP, GCFA, GCIH, GIAC, or EnCE

Our focus is simple:
Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

title: Traveling Electronic Security Systems Technician
description:
Who We Are

Evergreen Fire and Security (EFS) is a recognized leader in the life safety and security solutions industry. We are entrusted by the Federal Government and commercial customers to protect lives, critical infrastructure, and information by providing and maintaining technically advanced and innovative fire alarm, access control, intrusion detection, CCTV, mass notification, and other critical protection systems.

The Key to Our Success

Our success is largely due to the experience, skills, and expertise of the best and brightest employees in the industry. Due to growth, we are looking for additional qualified experts to join the Evergreen team. Think you have what it takes? Great! We welcome you to submit your qualifications for this great Evergreen Fire and Security career opportunity.

The Opportunity

This opportunity as a Traveling Electronic Security Systems Technician is perfect for an experienced low-voltage technician who enjoys traveling!

The Responsibilities

  • Installs, repairs, tests, and maintains security projects
  • Serves as the face of Evergreen to our customers onsite by providing top-notch service and product training
  • Ensures safety through compliance with relevant State and Federal regulations
  • Handles service orders and project administration
  • Performs follow-up to ensure the client is ready for inspection

The Necessities

  • Ability to travel extensively
  • Valid CPR/First Aid card
  • Valid electrician certificate or trainee card
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Electrical wiring experience
  • Basic computer skills (Microsoft Office)
  • Good communication skills to interface with customers
  • Ability to call and schedule appointments, follow instructions, and understand code requirements
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to work autonomously
  • Ability to work well with others and come to work with a positive attitude
  • Valid driver’s license and proof of minimum liability insurance
  • Ability to pass pre-employment and continuing random background, drug, and MVR screenings

Great to Have

  • Relevant factory certifications and knowledge are always a plus. Great examples include:
    • Lenel
    • DAQ Access Control/IDS
    • Milestone CCTV
    • Pelco CCTV
    • Monitor Dynamics Access Control/IDS
    • AMAG
    • Various DDC and Building Utility Control Systems
  • Prior experience working on government contracts or military bases
  • Ability to obtain a U.S. government clearance

The Benefits

Here at Evergreen, we pay competitive wages and benefits, but we also go the extra mile for our Technicians, and even more so for those who travel frequently. Sound good? Check these out:

Awesome Travel Perks!

  • Additional weeks of paid leave for extended travel—up to 320 additional hours of time off!
  • Paid flights for weekends at home for regional travel
  • Weekly per diem for meals, incidentals, and lodging paid to you
  • Paid TSA Pre-Check
  • Work-related travel miles and hotel points are yours to keep

Employee Benefits

  • Competitive pay
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans
  • 401(k) plan
    • Up to 4% match available
    • 100% vested from day one
  • Healthcare flexible spending accounts
  • Dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Company-sponsored group term life insurance
  • Corporate perks program
  • Opportunities to participate in voluntary benefits such as pet insurance, voluntary life insurance, disability insurance, long-term care, hospital indemnity insurance, critical illness insurance, legal services, identity theft protection, and accident insurance

Pay range is $38 - $45 per hour for well-qualified candidates.

We also offer opportunities for training and advancement in a fast-paced, inclusive, and rewarding working environment. Check us out on Facebook, LinkedIn, or at www.evergreenfire.com.

Evergreen Fire & Security is a US government contractor with sensitive access requirements. As our employee, you must also be able to satisfy federal government requirements for access to government information. Unless otherwise stated in the requirements section of an individual job listing, our positions require U.S. citizenship due to the level of access to sensitive information and/or restricted facilities.

title: Chief Strategy Officer
description:
Agency :

Ledger Bennett

Job Description :

We are seeking a transformational Chief Strategy Officer to shape the future of our agency and our clients' brands. As a key member of the Executive Leadership Team, the CSO will define and drive the agency's strategic vision, elevate our brand and creative strategy capabilities, and build a world-class global strategy function that powers sustainable growth across markets.

This is not a traditional planning leadership role. We are looking for a strategist who can connect business ambition, brand purpose, customer insight, creativity, data, technology and culture to create competitive advantage for both our clients and our agency. They will work with other strategy lead across Havas agencies to create joint propositions that give us unique offerings for clients globally.

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing and scaling strategic hubs across global markets, creating integrated centres of excellence that deliver consistent strategic thinking while enabling local relevance and market expertise. They will champion the next generation of B2B marketing, ensuring our agency stays ahead of shifts in buyer behaviour, AI-enabled marketing, creativity, channel innovation and brand building. This role will be instrumental in elevating our reputation as one of the world's most strategically influential B2B agencies.

Key Responsibilities

Agency Strategy & Vision

  • Define and lead the agency's long-term strategic vision in partnership with the CEO and Executive Leadership Team.
  • Shape the agency's market positioning, service evolution along with the CEO and other agency leaders to ensure continued relevance and differentiation.
  • Identify emerging opportunities, industry trends and market shifts that can unlock competitive advantage.
  • Act as a strategic catalyst across the business, driving innovation and future-focused thinking.

Brand & Creative Strategy Leadership

  • Build a world-class strategic planning function renowned for excellence in B2B brand building and creative effectiveness.
  • Lead the development of transformative brand, communications and customer experience strategies for key global clients.
  • Ensure strategy serves as the foundation for outstanding creativity and measurable business impact.
  • Champion the integration of brand, demand generation, customer engagement and reputation-building approaches.
  • Establish best-in-class strategic frameworks, methodologies and planning tools across the agency (and international hubs).

Global Markets & Hub Development

  • Design and implement a global strategic operating model that supports agency growth across regions and markets.
  • Establish and scale strategy hubs and centres of excellence across priority global markets.
  • Create consistent standards, processes and capabilities while allowing for cultural and regional nuance.
  • Foster collaboration across geographic teams to create a connected and high-performing global strategy community.
  • Identify opportunities for market expansion, acquisitions, partnerships and capability building.

Client Leadership & Growth

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite client stakeholders and senior decision makers.
  • Lead strategic engagements with key global accounts and participate in major business reviews.
  • Support new business growth through compelling strategic thinking, positioning and pitch leadership.
  • Translate complex business challenges into actionable opportunities for clients and agency teams.
  • Strengthen long-term client relationships through strategic value creation.

Innovation & Future Readiness

  • Lead the agency's approach to AI, data-driven planning, customer intelligence and predictive marketing.
  • Ensure strategic thinking evolves alongside technological change and emerging customer expectations.
  • Create a future-focused culture that embraces experimentation and continuous learning.
  • Establish partnerships with industry experts, research organisations and innovation networks.

Talent & Leadership

  • Build, inspire and develop a diverse, high-performing global strategy team.
  • Create clear career pathways and a culture of strategic excellence.
  • Mentor senior strategists and emerging leaders across the organisation with the added challenge of being located in different markets/time zones.
  • Foster strong collaboration between strategy, creative, client services, media, social, digital and analytics teams.
  • Raise the overall strategic capability and commercial acumen of the agency.

Experience

  • 15+ years of strategic leadership experience within a leading agency, consultancy, marketing services business or marketing dept in a global brand.
  • Significant experience leading brand, communications and creative strategy at a regional or global level.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing strategy teams.
  • Experience developing international operations, markets, hubs or centres of excellence.
  • Strong track record of driving agency growth, client retention and new business success.
  • Deep understanding of B2B marketing and the evolving relationship between brand building and commercial performance.
  • Full funnel B2B marketing experience

Key Outcomes

Within 12-24 months, the Chief Strategy Officer will have:

  • Established a globally connected strategy organisation with clearly defined market hubs and centres of excellence.
  • Elevated the agency's reputation as a strategic leader in global B2B marketing.
  • Support the delivery of 20-25% agency revenue growth through strategic leadership of key accounts, proposition development and new business activity.
  • Ensure strategy function directly contributes to at least 50% of all new business wins.
  • Built market-leading brand and creative strategy capabilities.
  • Embedded innovative, AI-enabled and insight-driven planning practices throughout the agency.
  • Created a high-performing strategy, and globally scalable strategy team capable of supporting sustained international growth.
  • Design and launch a global strategy operating model within the first six months.
  • Establish new regional strategy hubs across key markets
  • Implement standardised strategic frameworks, planning tools and processes across 100% of agency locations and achieve adoption by all strategy teams within year one
  • Increase multi-market strategic project delivery by 30%.
  • Ensure every major global client has access to integrated hub expertise.
  • Develop and implement a strategy quality framework.
  • Reduce strategy development cycle times by 20% through improved processes and AI-enabled tools.

You will work closely with our Head of Engineering to define and uphold frontend engineering standards, lead our Communities of Practice, develop the engineers around you, and act as a trusted technical partner to our clients. At the same time, you will remain hands‑on - taking on Tech Lead responsibilities within client engagements when needed and leading by example in craft.

This is not a purely managerial role, nor a purely technical one. It requires fluency across both and the credibility to operate at the Principal level in all three pillars of our framework: client work, internal collaboration, and technical specialism.

Mentor engineers across the practice, not just your direct reports — actively developing the next generation of Senior and Principal‑level talent

Define and maintain the hiring bar for frontend engineering; lead and shape our interview process

Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and high standards

Community of Practice Leadership

Lead the Frontend Engineering Community of Practice — set the agenda, drive output, and ensure it creates real value for the engineers involved

Champion best practices in frontend development across the practice: component architecture, testing, accessibility, performance, and developer tooling

Collaborate with Principal Consultants across Delivery, UCD, QA, and DevOps to align strategy and drive cross‑functional improvements

Drive internal initiatives that produce lasting, measurable improvements to how we work

Client Engagement & Delivery

Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders — translating business challenges into scalable frontend engineering approaches

Lead or materially contribute to technical proposals, architecture sessions, and pre‑sales conversations

Take on Tech Lead or Senior Developer responsibilities within client engagements, setting technical direction and ensuring engineering excellence throughout the delivery lifecycle

Handle complex and challenging client situations with confidence and composure — including escalations and high‑pressure delivery moments

Contribute to the retention and growth of client accounts through the quality of your technical leadership and relationships

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Background

8+ years of experience in frontend software engineering, with meaningful time at Senior Consultant level or equivalent

A track record of technical leadership on complex, client‑fac­ing engagements — not just strong individual contribution

Demonstrable experience mentoring or managing engineers and helping them grow

Prior experience in a consultancy or agency environment is strongly preferred

Technical

Shape how intelligent agents discover, retrieve, evaluate, and reason over real-time web information.
Lead applied AI research across retrieval, ranking, grounding, and multi-step agentic workflows.
Design systems that operate over constantly changing, unstructured data at significant scale.
Balance relevance, latency, reliability, and cost while supporting high-throughput production workloads.
Define new evaluation approaches for agentic systems where traditional search metrics are no longer sufficient.

  • Define new evaluation frameworks, metrics, and experimentation methodologies for agentic systems, recognizing that effectiveness cannot be measured solely through traditional click-based metrics.
  • Lead experimentation with modern retrieval technologies, including embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, and related approaches, and transition successful methods into production.
  • Analyze and manage trade-offs between relevance, latency, reliability, and infrastructure cost at scale.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to deploy AI and retrieval systems in high-throughput, low-latency production environments.

    • Strong understanding of modern deep learning, particularly transformer architectures and embeddings.
    • Experience building LLM-integrated, knowledge-intensive, or retrieval-augmented systems.
    • Practical experience designing evaluation frameworks and meaningful metrics for machine learning or AI systems.
    • Strong programming skills in Python and proficiency in at least one additional language such as Go, C++, or a comparable systems-oriented language.
    • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, product-oriented environment with significant ownership and autonomy.

title: Sr. Tech Infra Program Manager, Global Network Deployment (GND)
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The successful candidate for this role will create sustainable processes and standards; and drive automation opportunities to reduce delivery cycle times and to improve quality without impacting network availability.

The mission of the team is to deliver network capacity on time with zero rework. The GND Technical Program Manager will support the implementation and delivery of inbound capacity and equipment. They will be responsible for bringing efficiencies in operations and allow the team to scale.

Key job responsibilities
1. Resolves Planning gaps by driving joint outcomes with stakeholder teams within GND.

2. Owns identifying where systematic issues are blocking planner throughput, driving those to resolution across team boundaries.

3. Collaborates on initiatives within GND that impact Planning (e.g. attend MBRs), and ensures that AMER, EMEA, and APAC regional teams are learning from each other rather than solving the same problems in silos.

4. Provides forward visibility, surfacing risks before they become blockers, engaging the right decision-makers, and driving resolution so planners stay focused on planning and their time is not spent chasing other teams.

5. Ensures solutions are grounded in how planners actually work, translating operational pain points into actionable requirements, representing planning in design discussions, and validating that what ships actually solves the problem.

6. Owns how improvements land in the planning workflow - sequencing rollouts, enabling planners, and confirming that the change actually helps. Drives adoption of tools.

7. Optimizes business processes through Agentic AI solutions.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: System Development Engineer, Keya
description:
Application deadline: Sep 22, 2026

The Keya team owns and operates the Customer Experience (CX) services that power AWS User Experience Products and Platforms (UXP2), Documentation, and SDKs within US Government dedicated cloud partitions. We are responsible for the scaling, reliability, and regional expansion of these services—ensuring that AWS's government customers have a seamless, secure, and performant experience across console, SDK, and documentation touchpoints.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
Our work spans the breadth of AWS: from build automation and service operations to development of tools that accelerate region launches and maintain experience parity across dedicated cloud environments.

Our work spans the breadth of AWS: from build automation and service operations to development of tools that accelerate region launches and maintain experience parity across dedicated cloud environments.

We are looking for a System Development Engineer to help us build, scale, and operate critical services that directly impact how US Government customers interact with AWS. You'll work on a collaborative, geographically distributed team that values autonomy, ownership, and technical depth.

A day in the life
No two days on Keya look the same—but here's what a typical day might look like:

You are a builder who thrives on solving real-world problems at scale. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, you take ownership of outcomes (not just tasks), and you're energized by the challenge of keeping critical systems running reliably for customers who depend on them. You bring strong technical fundamentals, a bias for automation over manual work, and the curiosity to learn new systems quickly—because on Keya, you'll touch a lot of them.

You start your morning reviewing service dashboards and alarms, checking the health of the CX services your team owns across dedicated cloud partitions. After standup with your distributed team, you dive into a design document for a new automation that will cut a manual region-launch task from hours to minutes.

Mid-morning, you pair with a teammate to debug a latency spike in one of your APIs—tracing the issue across service boundaries, identifying a misconfigured retry policy, and pushing a fix through your CI/CD pipeline. After lunch, you join a cross-team architecture review with engineers from another AWS service team, providing input on how their changes will interact with your services in government partitions.

Later in the afternoon, you're writing code—maybe building a new CloudWatch alarm integration, extending an internal CLI tool, or implementing a feature on your team's roadmap. You wrap up the day by updating your design doc based on feedback from a senior engineer and queuing up a code review for tomorrow.

title: System Development Engineer, Region Services Corporate Infrastructure (RSCI) Team
description:
Region Services Corporate Infrastructure (RSCI) Core Services owns the foundational Windows
infrastructure that every team in Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) depends on — Active Directory,
DNS, DHCP, DFS, Group Policy, and Enterprise Configuration Manager (ECM). These services run
across multiple isolated environments supporting U.S. Government customers.

We are not looking for someone to maintain the status quo. Our team is transforming from a
manually-operated infrastructure organization into a DevOps-driven engineering team. We need a
Systems Development Engineer who will own the design and implementation of our automation
architecture — building the Ansible frameworks, AWS pipelines, and operational tooling that eliminate manual processes and enable our services to scale.

This is not a "write a playbook when you get time" role. You will architect how we codify, deploy,
configure, and lifecycle-manage Windows infrastructure services through automation. You will
design reusable Ansible roles and collections, build CI/CD pipelines using AWS CDK, instrument
services with CloudWatch monitoring, and establish the patterns that the rest of the team adopts.
You need working familiarity with the Windows services we manage — but your primary value is
your ability to engineer the systems that manage them.

You will also participate in an on-call rotation, owning incidents for the services your automation
manages. When things break, you fix them — and then you build the automation that prevents
recurrence.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
Own automation architecture: Design and implement the Ansible automation framework
(roles, collections, inventories, execution patterns) that manages Core Services infrastructure at scale
• Build delivery pipelines: Develop and maintain AWS CI/CD pipelines (CDK, CodePipeline,
CodeBuild) that deliver infrastructure changes through tested, repeatable deployments
• Instrument and monitor: Build CloudWatch-based observability — dashboards, alarms, and
metrics — that provide proactive visibility into service health across isolated environments
• Operate and support: Maintain production Windows infrastructure services (AD, DNS,
DHCP, DFS, ECM, Group Policy); participate in on-call rotation and provide escalation
support
• Eliminate manual operations: Identify, prioritize, and migrate manual runbook processes to
code-defined, version-controlled automation
• Establish engineering standards: Define patterns for infrastructure-as-code, testing, code

What This Role Is NOT:
• This is not a desktop support or endpoint engineering role
• This is not a "keep the lights on" operations role where automation is a side project
• This is not a Linux/Unix position — our infrastructure is Windows, our automation targets Windows, and our scripting is PowerShell-heavy
• This is a role where you are expected to write code daily, own systems end-to-end, and drive architectural decisions
review, and deployment that the team follows — raise the engineering bar
• Mentor and lead technically: Guide junior engineers on automation practices, code quality,
and operational excellence; drive technical design reviews
• Maintain documentation: Create and maintain architecture documentation, automation
design docs, and operational runbooks

A successful Software Development Engineer II joining the team will be an innovator, building solutions and working closely with Amazon's largest and most demanding government customers to address their specific needs across a suite of Frontier AI services in GovCloud and isolated environments. This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will:

• Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history". The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.

• Have strong Linux & Networking Fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with Linux, preferably in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting and conduct technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

• Have strong software and systems skills. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with systems in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You are comfortable facilitating deep-dive troubleshooting and leading technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

• Love to solve problems. The ideal candidate will love leading teams to solve difficult technical problems related to AWS service builds and operations in GovCloud and isolated environments. You have a solid understanding of systems design, operations, automation, and process improvement.

• Think Big. The ideal candidate will work on projects building and deploying solutions across GovCloud and isolated regions. You will strive to build a culture to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer II in Frontier ADC, you will build innovative solutions, expand services into GovCloud and isolated regions, and improve our operations to provide resiliency and the best experience for our customers. You influence technical strategy and architectural decisions within the team and with partner teams and make data-driven decisions. Successful candidates will be expected to show leadership on strong Bias for Action, Invent and Simplify, Insist on the Highest Standards, and Deliver Results.

You will develop, build, and operate AWS Frontier AI services that enable customers to leverage generative AI and agentic capabilities in secure environments. Our engineering teams support services running in GovCloud and isolated regions, creating unique engineering challenges and opportunities for innovation. The Frontier ADC team is responsible for diving deep to resolve operational challenges, innovating to automate operational tasks, building solutions for our customers, supporting execution of various security campaigns (blocked software, host patching), and parity programs.

As a Software Development Engineer II you will:

• Work cross-functionally to foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues.

• Love to code. Whether it's building tools in Java or solving complex system problems in Python, the ideal candidate will love using technology to solve problems.

• Think Big. The ideal candidate will build and deploy solutions across thousands of devices. You will strive to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

    • Data historians and databases.
    • Network infrastructure design, development, and cybersecurity for industrial control systems.

  • Familiarity with IIOT, data analytics, and cloud integration.
  • Strong background in application development methodologies for automation projects.
  • Highly-organized, self-motivated, and able to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to lead innovation initiatives, including those related to smart water systems, energy optimization, and predictive maintenance.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and Outlook.

Garver offers its employees programs such as company-paid professional memberships, company support for industry licenses and continuing education opportunities that foster a progressive atmosphere. Garver provides the tools, resources, and environment to develop leaders, stimulate ideas, and accomplish projects. By offering highly competitive salary packages, attractive benefits, and a comprehensive wellness program; Garver walks the talk when it comes to work-life balance.

Cyber (UK) Business

Join the team redefining defense technology. From engineering systems that save lives to leading programs that change the battlefield—find your place in the future of defense.

The Ultra Engineering function manages a portfolio of specialist capabilities, generating highly differentiated solutions and products by applying, systematically, electronic, mechanical, and software technologies in demanding and critical environments to meet customer needs. Within the Engineering function the Systems Engineering discipline ensures a defined multi/inter-discipline approach and assures the cross-discipline solution/products support a compliant system, offering a means to gain stakeholder acceptance.

The Principal Systems Lead role is responsible for, and assures, a hierarchical implementation of the ISO 15288 processes and practices across the Systems Engineering life cycle, for the assigned project. This Lead role owns the solution in response to the collective technical requirements; furthering the clarity of the requirements for engagement and flow down to the other disciplines; managing the delivery of the required deliverables associated to the candidate solution/capability, whilst also assuring the evidence-base offers a managed approach to progressive acceptance.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Represents the Systems discipline as the lead Systems Engineer assigned to a project, owning the totality of the Systems assigned work packages and tasking, to deliver obligations and commitments to the enabling technical requirements, agreed processes, plans, quality, schedule and budget.

- Provide technical direction and exert technical influence across the numerous project work packages, such that the optimal approach, applicable processes, risk mitigations, architecture, design, and implementation are selected/identified.

- Leads, manages and reports Systems aspects of the project to achieve optimal balance between requirements, solution maturity, technical risk, schedule and cost.
- Manage customers and external suppliers to define and achieve expectations and objectives, where the System lead achieves acceptance via the technical solution and related products/artefacts.
- Having delivered the solution acts as the Design Authority (DA), supporting the in-service phase and future opportunities/change.
- Ensure and review technical/task proposals, providing accurate estimates for the associated effort, costs and risks, for bids and proposals, leading to contract award.
- Technically lead other project discipline lead/s, working with project management and engineering project leads, to create proposals associated to the technical solution, that drive down project costs, risk and increase margin.

- Actively supports and offers value add improvements to the Systems discipline to grow the overall capability as a whole.

- Leads others, in Systems and outside, to develop greater awareness and implementation of a systems approach, practices and applicable processes.
- Line Management duties, proactively leading and coaching reports, aid the creation of development plans and support execution, whilst measuring continuous improvement in others.

**Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications**

- Degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or have suitable Defence/Aerospace industry experience.
- Significant experience and a full understanding of Systems Engineering, the lifecycle, various development models and associated processes.
- Significant experience of developing high quality requirements and establishing a fully compliant systems design.
- Demonstrable experience in implementing the full Systems Engineering lifecycle as per the applicable ISO/IEEE/IEC standards.
- Technical and Line management experience of a team of systems engineers
- Experience in writing high quality technical documentation and the formal technical review of such material.
- Substantial knowledge of System Engineering practices, methodologies, processes, techniques and technology trends.
- Experience of requirement management and modelling tools.
- Previous experience of hands-on development of either hardware, software or firmware development, particularly in an embedded environment.

**Desirable Experience, Skills and Qualifications**

- Experience working as a technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) and developing new areas of expertise as and when required.

title: Systems Development Engineer, ADC - RAPP (Route 53 and Perimeter Protection)
description:
Application deadline: Sep 22, 2026

Would you like to implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve the world's most complex technical problems? Do you have a deep passion and desire to engineer and operate the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure to build a better world for future generations?

This is an exciting opportunity to use the latest cloud computing technologies to help U.S. Government agencies implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve technical problems.

AWS established a specialized group of service teams responsible for the work we are doing with the U.S. Intelligence Community. We are building some of the largest and most complex distributed systems in the world, and we need adaptable people to help us implement and operate them.

The AWS RAPP (Route 53 and Perimeter Protection) ADC team is seeking highly motivated engineers who are focused on operational excellence, troubleshooting complex system operations, have a good understanding of Linux, networking, and general knowledge of cloud services. We're also looking for engineers who can use their software knowledge to automate the way we manage and scale our services. We need engineers who understand how to think big, and simplify solutions to complex problems; all the while ensuring that our customers continue to have the best experience possible.

You will be able to take a defined project, break down the work to help define milestones and feedback mechanisms. You identify when implementations are not highly available or have defects; you investigate systemic patterns. You resolve, mitigate, or escalate operational concerns in a timely manner.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
Ensure Route 53 and Perimeter Protection services are able to offer customers a 100% uptime SLA. We do this through deploying software, troubleshooting software failures, and minimizing the need for human involvements through automation such as infrastructure as code and operator tools.

A day in the life
It’s always Day 1 at Amazon. On a typical day, a RAPP System Development Engineer manages and monitors systems in air-gapped regions, and builds software based solutions to improve how we manage and monitor our systems.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

title: SharePoint/Power App Developer
description:
About The Role

As a SharePoint/Power App Developer in our Cybersecurity department, you will design, build, and maintain secure, scalable collaboration solutions that support critical security operations. Leveraging your experience with Power Applications, SharePoint, and Power BI, you will partner closely with cybersecurity analysts, engineers, and leadership to streamline workflows, improve data visibility, and enhance the security posture of our digital workplace. This salaried, full-time role requires a strong understanding of modern Microsoft 365 capabilities as well as a commitment to security-by-design principles in every solution you deliver.


What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain SharePoint sites, pages, lists, libraries, and workflows that support Cybersecurity processes and initiatives.
  • Build and customize Power Apps solutions to digitize and automate cybersecurity-related workflows, requests, and approvals.
  • Develop and maintain Power Automate flows to integrate systems, automate routine tasks, and ensure secure data movement between platforms.
  • Create and optimize Power BI dashboards and reports to provide actionable insights into security metrics, incident trends, and operational performance.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity stakeholders to gather requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and deliver secure, user-friendly solutions.
  • Implement and enforce security, permission models, and governance standards across SharePoint and related Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Optimize performance, reliability, and usability of existing SharePoint, Power Apps, and Power BI solutions through continuous enhancement and refactoring.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to SharePoint sites, Power Apps, Power Automate flows, and Power BI reports.
  • Document solution designs, configurations, data flows, and standard operating procedures for ongoing support and compliance needs.
  • Stay current on Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, and cybersecurity best practices to recommend and implement improvements.
  • Support change management activities, including user training, demonstrations, and communication of new or updated solutions.
  • Collaborate with IT security and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions align with organizational security policies, compliance requirements, and data protection standards.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a SharePoint Developer or in a closely related Microsoft 365 development role.
  • An Active Power Platform Certification
  • Proven hands-on experience designing and developing solutions with SharePoint Online (or SharePoint 2016+), including site architecture, lists, libraries, and permissions.
  • Strong experience with Power Applications (Power Apps), including building canvas and/or model-driven apps that integrate with SharePoint and other data sources.
  • Practical experience with Power Automate for workflow automation, system integration, and process orchestration.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modeling, DAX, and secure data access.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity concepts such as access control, least-privilege principles, data classification, and secure configuration of Microsoft 365 services.
  • Ability to gather and analyze business requirements and convert them into effective, secure technical solutions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 ecosystem tools and services (e.g., Teams, OneDrive, Azure AD) and their integration with SharePoint and Power Platform.
  • Solid knowledge of web technologies relevant to SharePoint customization (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON) and modern SharePoint frameworks is preferred.
  • Experience implementing and managing SharePoint permissions, governance policies, and content lifecycle management.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Effective communication skills in English, with the ability to work cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Activity Assistant- MC and Traditional

description:
Activity Assistant

Part-Time | Arbors/Ivy Assisted Living Community

At Arbors/Ivy, we believe seniors deserve joy, connection, and purpose — especially in their later years. We are family-centered, integrity-driven, and committed to creating a vibrant community where residents feel known, valued, and excited about each day.

We are looking for an Activity Assistant who understands something important:

Sometimes “no” really means “I’m unsure.”
Sometimes “I don’t want to go” really means “I’m nervous.”

Your job is not to push — but to warmly, respectfully coax. To gently encourage. To spark curiosity. To help residents feel safe enough to step into fun.

This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who:

  • Stays cheerful even when plans change unexpectedly
  • Understands that flexibility is part of the job
  • Doesn’t get flustered when things are out of their control
  • Follows policies and procedures carefully
  • Has a genuine heart for seniors and their final chapters
  • Is friendly, upbeat, and naturally encouraging
  • Knows how to read the room and respond with compassion

Activities don’t always go as planned. Residents may hesitate. Weather may shift. Schedules may change.

Your steady, positive presence is what keeps the energy moving forward.

What You’ll Do

  • Engage, escort, and motivate residents to attend activities
  • Create a welcoming, inclusive environment where everyone feels safe to participate
  • Provide meaningful 1:1 visit for residents who prefer quieter engagement

  • Observe engagement levels and communicate insights to the Activity Director
  • Support a culture of teamwork and collective ownership

You are not just filling seats.
You are building confidence.
You are helping someone try something new when they’re unsure.
You are protecting joy in a season of life that deeply matters.

You’ll Thrive Here If You:

  • Can pivot quickly without losing your positivity
  • Stay calm when the unexpected happens
  • Believe rules and structure matter
  • Naturally encourage others
  • Take pride in doing things the right way
  • Want your work to have meaning beyond a paycheck

Requirements

  • Associate’s degree preferred or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 1 year experience working with elders (home care, assisted living, or skilled nursing)
  • Dependable, compassionate, and team-oriented

Benefits

At Arbors/Ivy, we do whatever it takes to create excellence in resident experience. We work hard, support one another, and share plenty of laughter along the way.

If you are flexible, cheerful, rule-following, compassionate — and ready to help seniors step into joy even when they’re hesitant — we would love to meet you.

title: Senior Azure AI Developer
description:
