title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
Supply Chain Coordinator

Hausbeck Pickle Company’s mission is to produce & deliver the highest quality food products with enthusiasm & integrity while striving for win-win partnerships with our customers and suppliers.

Hausbeck Pickle Company is now an employee-owned company (ESOP). While Hausbeck Pickle Company has always been a family-oriented environment, establishing an ESOP is a way to honor employees for their stellar work and empower and reward them through shared equity for striving towards an even higher goal.

Please consider joining a team whose vision is to share the FUN, FLAVOR & FREEDOM of our food products with everyone, making the world a tastier place!

Job Summary

The Supply Chain Coordinator is responsible for owning and managing the company's production schedule to ensure customer demand is met efficiently, materials and resources are available, and production capacity is utilized effectively. This position serves as the central connection between Production, Purchasing, Warehouse, Quality, Sales, Customer Service, and Operations. The Production Scheduler is responsible for establishing production priorities, developing and maintaining the production schedule, identifying constraints, resolving scheduling conflicts, and communicating changes throughout the organization.

Benefits – Medical, dental and vision; STD, LTD and Life company paid; 401k with company match. Employee pays only 15% of medical cost for all coverage levels. Company contributes HSA dollars annually of $1,000 for a Single and $2,000 for a Family.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Production Scheduling

  • Optimize and utilize the company’s ERP system to manage purchasing, inventory, production requirements, material availability, costing, and sales/demand information. Maintain accurate system data and use ERP reporting to support operational and purchasing decisions.
  • Create and manage the production schedule weekly and make daily adjustments as needed to address changes such as delayed resources, equipment failures, or other disruptions.
  • Monitor production progress daily to ensure the monthly goal remains on track.
  • Proactively communicate risks, delays, or resource constraints when performance is not tracking to plan and take corrective action to support achievement of the monthly target.
  • Coordinate closely with all departments to communicate and manage changes to incoming pepper and pickle deliveries, ensuring timely updates, accurate scheduling, and minimal disruption to production and receiving operations.
  • Schedule and manage the transfer of input inventory and WIP. Coordinate incoming pepper loads to support uninterrupted production.
  • Use data from the ERP system, supplier commitments, customer forecasts, inventory levels, and cost analysis to make informed decisions regarding purchase timing, contracted volumes, supplier allocation, and supply risk.
  • Report ERP issues to appropriate team members.
  • Other duties may be assigned as necessary.
  • Some travel required.

Supply Chain Coordination

  • Negotiate and manage raw product contracts with growers and brokers, ensuring terms align with established quality specifications, pricing requirements, volume needs, delivery expectations, and overall business objectives.
  • Maintain proactive communication with suppliers to ensure timely and accurate deliveries, keep inventory and scheduling current, and provide timely, accurate information to the Production and Inventory Receiving departments.
  • Partner closely with internal Sales team to understand expected sales volumes, forecasts, promotional activity, new business opportunities, and changing demand patterns. Translate customer volume expectations into actionable purchasing, inventory, and supply plans utilizing the company’s ERP system, ensuring timely and reliable data to support production planning, inventory management, and business decision-making.
  • Support the supplier scorecard program by providing timely feedback, maintaining accurate performance data, and monitoring supplier results to ensure produce suppliers meet Hausbeck’s quality, service, reliability, and performance expectations. Help identify opportunities for supplier development and strengthen strategic partnerships that support continuous product improvement and Hausbeck’s long-term business objectives.
  • Monitor raw material, packaging, and finished-goods inventory levels to ensure appropriate supply while minimizing excess, aging, obsolescence, and waste. Establish and maintain inventory targets and proactively identify potential shortages or overages.
  • Manage the purchasing of prime materials and other key raw materials based on forecasted demand, customer requirements, inventory position, production needs, quality specifications, and cost objectives. Build and maintain strong, productive relationships with suppliers to ensure reliable supply, consistent quality, competitive pricing, and timely resolution of issues.
  • Communicate timely to suppliers regarding supply chain issues requiring attention.
  • Actively participate in floor level activities, continuous improvement or quality related issues.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Production planning and purchasing experience
  • Strong experience in ERP/MRP systems, supplier and contract management, inventory and demand planning and data-driven decision making
  • Bachelor Degree in Supply Chain Management, Agribusiness, or Business preferred.
  • Advanced ability in the use of MSOffice, ERP and Supply Chain.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer, Community and Fandom - Music
description:
Hundreds of millions of people open Amazon Music to find the artists they love, build playlists that follow them everywhere, and share what they are listening to. The Community & Fandom team owns those social and discovery surfaces, including playlists, artist detail pages, profiles, insights and fan culture features that ship across iOS, Android and Fire Tablet.

We are hiring a Quality Assurance Engineer to help us change how quality gets built here. Our engineering org is moving fast on AI-assisted development, and code generation is no longer the constraint, validation is. That makes this role the leverage point for the entire team, not a downstream checkpoint. You will join at the moment we are doubling QA capacity and rebuilding our approach around automation, so the work you design in your first year becomes the way this org tests for years afterward.

The bugs we care about most are the ones that are hard to find. A playlist that loses a track for one customer in fifty thousand, a race condition that only surfaces on a cold start over a slow network, a memory pattern that degrades after an hour of listening. Finding those before customers do takes engineering judgment, and that is the bar we hire against.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end to end test strategy for features on your surfaces, from test case design through automation coverage and release sign off.
- Build and extend automated UI and integration test suites for Native and shared Kotlin and Compose Multiplatform code running on iOS and Android.
- Work inside our weekly release train, covering branch cut regression, staged rollout validation, and the metrics review that gates dial up to full traffic.
- Investigate low reproduction rate defects using logs, crash and memory telemetry, and weblab side by side comparisons, then turn each finding into a permanent regression test.
- Make accessibility a standing part of feature validation rather than an audit that happens late.
- Partner with our Quality Services team in India, contributing the documented test plans and environments they execute against, and reviewing their results as part of the daily handoff.
- Bring AI-assisted testing into the workflow, using LLM tooling for test case generation, coverage gap analysis, and triage acceleration, and measure whether it actually helps.

A day in the life
You start by reading overnight regression results from the QS team and triaging what changed. A crash signature spiked on the Android beta, so you pull the telemetry, narrow it to a specific playlist size, and reproduce it locally in twenty minutes. You file it with a repro case clear enough that the owning engineer fixes it before lunch. In the afternoon you pair with two SDEs on a new fan culture feature that is a week from branch cut, walking their design for the states nobody thought about yet. You close the day extending the automated suite so the crash you found this morning never ships again.



About the team
Community & Fandom is a mobile and backend org inside Amazon Music Technology. Two of our QAEs are already based in Mexico City, so you will have local peers from day one, and our engineering teams sit in overlapping timezones for real time collaboration. We are growing QA team to help accelerate delivery. We see QA as an integral part of our development flow and we're actively moving to a more deeply integrated QA model.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Foundational Services, AWS Applied AI Solution – Core Services
description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Join our Foundational Services team within Applied AI Solutions and help build the secure, reliable ecosystem of tools, services, and frameworks that powers AAIS's AI-driven business applications. We own critical foundational infrastructure spanning seven core pillars: Identity, Data and Knowledge, Foundational Agents, Evaluation, Onboarding, User Experience, and Data Analytics and Observability. Our platform abstracts complexity and eliminates undifferentiated heavy lifting, enabling AAIS builder teams to focus on differentiated innovation and reducing development time from months to days. This includes event-based data stores, machine learning training platforms, agent frameworks, identity management systems, and data access interfaces that enable responsible AI development while maintaining the highest standards of privacy, security, and compliance.

As a Software Development Engineer II, you'll take ownership of production systems and developer-facing platforms that empower internal builder teams to rapidly develop AI-powered enterprise applications, rather than rebuilding common agentic infrastructure from scratch. You'll handle the complete data lifecycle, from ingestion through model training to customer opt-out controls. You'll maintain and refactor existing services for enhanced performance and scalability, while designing new foundational solutions to meet emerging requirements from application teams. Working alongside scientists and engineers, you'll enable them to build and improve AI agents and models, balancing innovation with compliance requirements.

This role offers exciting opportunities to solve complex challenges around secure data storage, efficient querying at scale, and building self-service agentic platforms that empower development teams. You'll drive the evolution of established platforms to meet future needs, directly impacting how AWS delivers increasingly sophisticated AI-powered capabilities while ensuring customers maintain complete control over their data throughout every stage of processing.

Key job responsibilities
Own and deliver complete software features for event-based data storage systems and agentic infrastructure, from design through deployment and operations, ensuring they provide flexible, secure, and compliant platforms for AI-powered business applications
Maintain, refactor, and enhance existing foundational services and analytics platforms, identifying opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and operational excellence while eliminating technical debt
Design and implement software solutions for data access interfaces, agent frameworks, and authorization systems within established architectural strategies, seeking guidance from senior engineers when facing complex technical tradeoffs
Mentor team members through code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, providing meaningful feedback, training newcomers on system architecture, and facilitating technical discussions that promote operational excellence
Resolve operational issues by identifying root causes and implementing permanent fixes for compliance features, data deletion APIs, and customer opt-out mechanisms, going beyond quick workarounds
Work directly with internal builder teams and stakeholders to understand requirements, translating them into foundational tools and services that balance customer needs with platform sustainability
Take ownership of security implementations including encryption, access controls, audit trails, and PII handling, ensuring software can be maintained and extended by other engineers
Drive improvements to self-service agentic platforms and control planes, making priority tradeoffs between new feature development and operational work while maintaining governance standards.

A day in the life
You'll participate in engineering standups, providing updates on data storage features and resolving platform blockers. Your hands-on work includes refactoring services for performance, implementing secure data interfaces, and ensuring compliance through quality code and testing. You'll collaborate with scientists and engineers, helping them navigate data access patterns and authorization requirements while mentoring teammates through code reviews. When production issues arise, you investigate root causes to maintain reliable data deletion and opt-out mechanisms. Regular syncs with business application teams help you translate evolving requirements into technical solutions that balance innovation with security and compliance, while also documenting features and training teammates on system lifecycles.

About the team
ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Leasing Shared Services Coordinator
description:
Responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the processes related to project generation, issuance of site acquisition packages, contracts, agreements, and NTPs, arising from customer requests associated with the installation of telecommunications equipment on the ground and/or tower infrastructure within the company's site portfolio.

This position ensures that all BTS requests, colocations, additional equipment installations, amendments, and other contractual and operational requirements are processed in accordance with internal procedures, standards, and policies, guaranteeing timely and accurate deliverables, maintaining high-quality standards, and ensuring alignment with the applicable Master Service Agreements.

  • Timely register each opportunity in the designated corporate systems (Siterra, Salesforce, Tracker, Insite, or other applicable tools), ensuring full project traceability.
  • Review each request to ensure it includes all required site technical information, verifying that customer contractual rights and billing conditions are consistent with the applicable Master Agreement, thereby ensuring the quality and accuracy of the information provided.
  • Understand, interpret, and apply contractual provisions, including terms and conditions, renewals, lease rates, commercial arrangements, payment terms, and special clauses.

  • Monitor requests through periodic status reports, performance metrics, and KPIs, supporting effective decision-making and operational visibility.
  • Identify irregular or unauthorized equipment installations and initiate the corresponding review and analysis process.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction.
  • Participate in the development, testing, and continuous improvement of internal systems and tools.
  • Represent the department in internal and external meetings when required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in feasibility analysis, contract management, leasing, or telecommunications projects.
  • Experience in technical site analysis and/or telecommunications infrastructure contract management.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong knowledge of the Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience working with corporate systems such as Siterra, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
  • Advanced Spanish.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Strong functional and technical expertise.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
description:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

title: Director of AI Strategy and Enablement
description:
Who You Are

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

The Director of AI Strategy and Enablement leads the organization's enterprise AI strategy and establishes and operates the AI Center of Excellence. The role provides centralized leadership for AI governance, adoption, enablement, and value realization. This position partners with business and technology leaders to translate institutional priorities into a well-governed portfolio of high-value AI initiatives. The Director develops practical policies, standards, education programs, and operating models that accelerate innovation while protecting student, employee, and institutional data. Key outcomes include:

• An actionable AI roadmap

• An operational AI Center of Excellence

• A clear and effective AI governance framework

• Measurable adoption and productivity gains

• Clear executive reporting

• Effective management of AI, data, security, compliance, and vendor risk


Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $200,000 plus all full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and expertise being applied to the role.


What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

• Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.

• Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.

• Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.

• Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.

• Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.

• Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

• Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.

• Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.

• Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.

• Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time critical problems.

• Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

• Builds and maintains student satisfaction.

• Recognizes and anticipates student needs.


Day to Day Responsibilities

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

• Develop and maintain the enterprise AI strategy, roadmap, and investment portfolio aligned with ACE priorities, student outcomes, operational efficiency, and measurable value.

• Establish and operate the AI Center of Excellence, including governance forums, decision rights, intake processes, standards, and cross-functional accountability.

• Lead the AI Steering Committee to prioritize investments, resolve cross-functional decisions, and oversee value realization and responsible adoption.

• Partners with academic and administrative leaders to identify, shape, prioritize, and scale high-value AI use cases based on strategic fit, feasibility, risk, and adoption readiness.

• Guide AI initiatives from discovery through deployment and value realization, coordinating business ownership, delivery, change management, and continuous improvement.

• Define and maintain responsible AI policies, standards, controls, and lifecycle governance for internally developed, purchased, and embedded AI capabilities.

• Maintain the enterprise AI inventory and coordinate risk/impact assessments with Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and Data Governance.

• Deliver executive- and board-ready reporting on portfolio health, adoption, value realization, student/employee impact, risk, and control effectiveness.

• Advance AI literacy, role-based training, change management, and responsible adoption in partnership with HR, communications, and functional leaders.

• Evaluate platforms and vendors, build the AI strategy and governance capability, serve as a trusted advisor to executives, and monitor relevant regulatory and industry developments.


Qualifications and Education Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, data science, business, risk management, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered

• 8+ years of progressive experience in technology, data, digital transformation, analytics, risk, product, or strategy roles, including significant responsibility for enterprise-wide initiatives.

• 3+ years of experience leading AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, automation, responsible AI, or AI governance programs in a complex organization.

• Demonstrated success translating strategy into prioritized roadmaps, operating models, policies, and measurable business outcomes.

• Working knowledge of generative AI, machine learning lifecycles, data governance, privacy, cybersecurity, model risk, vendor risk, and cloud-based AI platforms.

• Experience designing or operating cross-functional governance, risk assessment, approval, monitoring, and value realization processes.

• Proven ability to communicate complex AI opportunities and risks clearly to executives, boards, and both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong leadership, change management, analytical, financial, and program execution skills in a remote, matrixed environment.

• Experience in higher education, education technology, or another regulated environment is preferred.

• Familiarity with recognized AI governance and risk frameworks (e.g., NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001) and relevant credentials (e.g., IAPP AIGP, ISACA AAIR/CRISC, cloud AI certifications, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer/Auditor) strongly preferred.


Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6 consecutive years, ACE was recognized as one of Indiana’s Best Places to Work, winning the #1 spot for medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition since 2022 for being a USA Today Top Workplace. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a family-like inclusive work environment. For our full-time employees, we offer the following benefits:

• Medical, dental, & vision Insurance

• HSA and FSA options

• Paid parental leave

• Paid volunteer time

• Tuition reimbursement & reduction programs

• Generous PTO

• 401k and employer match

• Full-service wellness and EAP program

• Employee recognition and awards programs

• Employer paid life & AD&D insurance

• Short-term disability

• Employer paid long-term disability

• And more…


Physical Demands

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in real time using online and other electronic media.


Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where everyone—students, faculty, and staff—can thrive. Guided by our mission and values, we focus on everything from innovative curriculum design to personalized instruction and student support to intentional planning, inclusive initiatives, and strategic resource allocation. We’re dedicated to creating an environment that celebrates freedom of expression, diversity of thought, open dialogue, and mutual respect. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered, valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Together, we’re creating a vibrant, resilient, and connected learning community where everyone matters.


Additional Notes

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Employees are increasingly integrating AI into their roles, demonstrating its potential to boost efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. By utilizing AI technologies, we can streamline processes, gain valuable insights from data, and automate routine tasks, which allows employees to concentrate on more strategic and creative aspects of their work. While AI is a beneficial tool in the workplace, if its use—such as ChatGPT, Grammarly, Copy.ai, etc.—accounts for more than 50% of any work assignments or job responsibilities, it will need to be reported to a direct leader.

Internet bandwidth speeds from an employee's remote work location must be a minimum of 50Mbps download speeds and 5Mbps upload speeds. Please note if the bandwidth is shared across multiple devices (tablets, computer, streaming, phone, etc.) you will need higher overall speeds. You can test the speed of your connection by visiting speedtest.net Purchase, setup, installation, support, and ongoing maintenance of reliable internet service is the responsibility of the individual.

American College of Education seeks to attract and retain a diverse staff consistent with its diverse student body and surrounding communities. At this time we cannot consider candidates residing in Alaska, Washington D.C., Massachusetts, South Dakota, or Alabama.

ACE is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (k/m/x) @ goodylabs sp. z o.o.
description:
Szukamy doświadczonego Senior DevOps Engineera (k/m/x), który chce pozostać blisko technologii, a jednocześnie mieć realny wpływ na standardy, priorytety i dalszy rozwój obszaru DevOps.

Wraz ze wzrostem liczby i złożoności projektów potrzebujemy kolejnej osoby z doświadczeniem seniorskim, która spojrzy na rozwiązania nie tylko przez pryzmat tego, czy działają, ale również ich bezpieczeństwa, stabilności, kosztów i możliwości dalszego utrzymania.

Docelowo będziesz wyznaczać techniczny kierunek rozwoju obszaru, dbać o spójność standardów, koordynować najważniejsze tematy oraz mieć wpływ na wybór technologii, narzędzi i dostawców chmurowych.

Pierwsze dwa miesiące przeznaczymy na poznanie projektów, środowisk, dokumentacji, wcześniejszych decyzji i najważniejszych ryzyk. W tym czasie zaczniesz również samodzielnie prowadzić wybrane tematy techniczne.

W pierwszym półroczu wśród ważnych tematów znajdą się m.in. automatyzacja procesów związanych z ISO 27001, rozwój zabezpieczeń Cloudflare WAF, dalsza standaryzacja i konteneryzacja wybranych środowisk oraz ocena zasadności planowanych zmian i migracji infrastruktury.

title: Feed Mill Operator (2nd Shift)
description:
2nd Shift: 2:00pm - 11:00pm

Position Overview & Responsibilities:

This role is responsible for executing daily production and load-out goals to established daily and weekly feed order levels. Key responsibilities include ensuring the proper use, upkeep, and maintenance of feed mill equipment, consistently achieving productivity goals, and cross-training to perform effectively across all mill manufacturing functions. Additionally, this position emphasizes maintaining the highest standards of customer service and fostering collaboration with various departments to support organizational success.

  • Operate load out equipment to properly load trucks in most efficient manner.
  • Perform and monitor proper documentation of the batching, grinding, loadout, and ingredient receiving.
  • Assist in warehouse operations as necessary.
  • Follow defined guidelines to produce quality feed.
  • Assist in routine preventative maintenance on feed mill equipment and maintain required documentation.
  • Responsible for proper feed and load out scheduling.
  • Responsible for proper bin management and utilization.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by supervisor.

None.

title: Systems Development Engineer, Frontier Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC)
description:
Application deadline: Sep 22, 2026

The Frontier ADC team is at the forefront of delivering the AWS GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio to our customers in GovCloud and isolated environments. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what is possible in this rapidly evolving field, leveraging the power of cloud computing and the latest advancements in artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies. With a focus on expanding Frontier AI services across GovCloud and isolated regions, driving automation investments, and delivering innovative solutions, we are at the forefront of modernization. Our teams are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed systems and delivering the next generation of cloud computing across the GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio. We support the GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio including services like Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Kiro.

We are seeking a Systems Development Engineer II who can think big and simplify solutions to complex problems, all while ensuring our customers continue to have the best experience possible!

A successful Systems Development Engineer II joining the team will be an innovator, building solutions and working closely with Amazon's largest and most demanding government customers to address their specific needs across a suite of Frontier AI services in GovCloud and isolated environments. They will drive the resolution of technical issues and work diligently to improve the customer experience.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will:

• Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history". The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.

• Have strong Linux & Networking Fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with Linux, preferably in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting and conduct technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

• Have strong software and systems skills. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with systems in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You are comfortable facilitating deep-dive troubleshooting and leading technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

• Love to solve problems. The ideal candidate will love leading teams to solve difficult technical problems related to AWS service builds and operations in GovCloud and isolated environments. You have a solid understanding of systems design, operations, automation, and process improvement.

• Think Big. The ideal candidate will work on projects building and deploying solutions across GovCloud and isolated regions. You will strive to build a culture to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

A day in the life
As a Systems Development Engineer II in Frontier ADC, you will build innovative solutions, expand services into GovCloud and isolated regions, and improve our operations to provide resiliency and the best experience for our customers. You influence technical strategy and architectural decisions within the team and with partner teams and make data-driven decisions. Successful candidates will be expected to show leadership on strong Bias for Action, Invent and Simplify, Insist on the Highest Standards, and Deliver Results.

You will develop, build, and operate AWS Frontier AI services that enable customers to leverage generative AI and agentic capabilities in secure environments. Our engineering teams support services running in GovCloud and isolated regions, creating unique engineering challenges and opportunities for innovation. The Frontier ADC team is responsible for diving deep to resolve operational challenges, innovating to automate operational tasks, building solutions for our customers, supporting execution of various security campaigns (blocked software, host patching), and parity programs.

As a Systems Development Engineer II you will:

• Work cross-functionally to foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues.

• Love to code. Whether it's building tools in Java or solving complex system problems in Python, the ideal candidate will love using technology to solve problems.

• Think Big. The ideal candidate will build and deploy solutions across thousands of devices. You will strive to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

title: Senior Windows System Administrator
description:
We are looking for Senior Windows Systems Administrator to join our team in Porto. The team will be responsible for the support functions in scope across all platform, ticket and incident management, continual service improvements and other tasks associated to the specific function of each team member.

Main Tasks and Responsabilities:

  • Infrastructure Support: Provide Level 2 and Level 3 Windows Server support.

  • Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve complex Windows Server and VMware virtualization issues.

  • ITIL Management: Handle incidents, problems, and change requests in line with ITIL frameworks.

  • Deployment & Patching: Install physical servers and deploy applications and patches using SCCM/MECM.

  • Automation: Develop and continuously improve PowerShell scripts and other automation tools.

  • Storage Management: Execute NetApp storage migration and implementation tasks.

  • Service Continuity: Maintain assets in operational condition (MCO) and ensure service quality meets SLA requirements.

  • Operations Coordination: Coordinate planned technical operations and participate in IT interventions and Disaster Recovery Plans (DRP).

  • System Monitoring: Participate in the oversight, monitoring, and proactive risk analysis of server environments.

  • Design & Alignment: Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining services to ensure infrastructure aligns with corporate Group standards.

  • Collaboration: Maintain close cooperative relationships with other entities and teams within the infrastructure department.

  • Security & Compliance: Follow, implement, and maintain industry-best security practices.

  • Documentation: Draft clear technical documentation and standard operational procedures.

What you will need to bring:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Technical Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • Deployment Tools: Experience with industrialization and deployment tools, specifically MECM/SCCM for application patching and deployment.

title: Operations Supervisor, Quick Commerce
description:
Please be aware that this role requires a commitment of 32 hours per week.

Location: Romford

Operations is the heart and soul of everything Amazon does. It is thanks to effective operations that items are processed and dispatched to our customers on time. Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.

Key job responsibilities
Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts
Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
Support the Shift/Area Manager with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance
Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity

A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.

You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. At other times, you’ll support your Shift/Area Manager in planning shifts to make sure you have enough team members working during peak times.

About the team
Quick Commerce (QC) delivers ultra-fast convenience through our network of small warehouse in city center locations, partnering with last-mile delivery providers to get products to customers in 30 minutes or less. We combine creative thinking and technological innovation to fulfill millions of urgent shopping missions, offering a curated selection of grocery items and Amazon essentials.
Our operations have two key components. Our 'under the roof' associates process orders with industry-leading speed, picking and packing customer orders to enable our 30-minute delivery promise. We operate with a people-first approach, with teams working across morning and afternoon shifts to serve customers seven days a week.
Meanwhile, our 'on the road' delivery network primarily utilizes Amazon Flex delivery partners on e-bikes specially optimized for rapid urban delivery. We continuously innovate to improve customer experience, focusing on sustainable delivery solutions in dense urban areas while maintaining strict quality and food safety standards.
Our team combines the best of Amazon's retail and logistics expertise, leveraging both Fresh and AMZL operational excellence. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages creative problem-solving and continuous improvement, as we work to revolutionize convenience shopping through ultra-fast delivery.

title: Tax Training Specialist

Summary
This is a blended role that will shift in focus throughout the year based on business needs. During busy season, this individual will perform billable client work similar to our Tax Seniors, supporting client engagements and contributing to the team’s workload. During the non-busy season, the focus will shift toward training, onboarding, and developing team members, along with other internal initiatives and process improvements.

Essential Functions
  • Training Design & Delivery
    • Assist in the planning, coordination, and delivery of tax training programs for new hires, experienced staff, and acquisition team members.
    • Facilitate and support virtual and in-person training sessions, workshops, and learning events.
    • Serve as a resource for employees seeking training information, guidance, and learning resources.

    • Help develop and maintain onboarding materials, learning plans, and training schedules.

  • Curriculum Development
    • Collaborate with the Manager of Tax Training & Education, subject matter experts, and department leaders to develop and enhance training materials.
    • Ensure training content remains accurate, current, and consistent with firm processes, policies, and best practices.
    • Help identify opportunities for new training content based on employee feedback, industry changes, and business needs.

    • Assist with the management of the annual tax training calendar and with the evaluation of training effectiveness through assessments, surveys, and feedback; use results to improve future sessions.
    • Support compliance with CPE requirements, including attendance tracking, documentation, and reporting requirements.
    • Prepare communications related to training programs, educational opportunities, deadlines, and learning resources.
  • Technology & Tools
    • Assist in maintaining training platforms, learning management systems, and training resource libraries.
    • Partner with the Manager of Tax Training & Education to evaluate and implement tools that enhance the learning experience and training effectiveness.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Tax, Education, or related field required.

Competencies

  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Adaptability and sensitivity in working with acquired teams during periods of transition.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
Why Join Us:
This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the development and success of our professionals. You'll play a key role in shaping the future of tax training in a collaborative, growth-focused environment that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and excellence in client service.

title: Processor - Gas House
description:
Innovative Chemical Products Group (ICP Group) is a leading formulator and manufacturer of specialty coatings, adhesives, and sealants serving the construction and industrial end markets. Founded in 2015 and supported by a lean corporate team, ICP Group has scaled rapidly through organic and acquisition growth into one of the largest coatings, adhesives, and sealants companies in North America. ICP Group is headquartered in Andover, MA and has manufacturing and distribution sites throughout North America, Latin America, UK, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

  • Must be self-motivated, organized, and detail oriented
  • Must be able to work in a non-temperature regulated environment
  • Ability to work in chemical manufacturing environment, involving solvents and other hazardous materials
  • Ability to repetitively lift up to 50 lbs. and perform other necessary physical requirements in performance of regular job duties

  • Maintain a clean, organized work area and company vehicle or assigned tools
  • Travel to various job sites as required
  • Perform other related duties within the scope of the electrical trade as assigned

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven experience working with commercial and/or industrial electrical systems
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and technical documentation
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining productivity and quality standards
  • Strong communication, troubleshooting, and time management skills
  • Ability to follow established procedures and detailed work instructions

Certifications and Education

  • High school diploma or GED preferred
  • OSHA safety training preferred
  • Valid state driver’s license required and must be maintained

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Complyance is a fully AI-native, end-to-end platform for Enterprise GRC. We are backed by leading VC firms including Google Ventures, Creandum, and HV Capital, and we’re in our hyper growth phase building a category-defining business in the governance, risk, and compliance space.

With customers like Major League Soccer, CVS Health, Dropbox, Penn State, O’Reilly Auto Parts, and more, Complyance re-defines how complex enterprises manage GRC. The platform offers deep, configurable core modules paired with customizable AI agents that automate entire manual workflows. From controls management (incl. audit prep), to risk management, third-party risk, policies, and trust, Complyance shortens cycle times by >80%, cuts manual work by >60%, and increases visibility over risk. Our clients start seeing cost savings and risk reduction within 3 months.

The role

We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer with strong product oriented mindset whose strongest area is backend engineering. Most of your work will involve TypeScript services, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, long-running workflows, and third-party integrations. You should be comfortable working in React and able to ship a feature from the data model through to the user interface.

What you’ll do

  • Own product capabilities from technical design through release and production support.
  • Design and build backend services using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Model data in PostgreSQL and build secure GraphQL and REST APIs.
  • Understand infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and explain tradeoffs clearly, and turn unclear requirements into a workable plan.
  • Build reliable background jobs and long-running workflows, including retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Integrate with third-party services using APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and scheduled processes.
  • Protect customer data through clear authorization, tenant isolation, and careful handling of sensitive information.
  • Work closely with Product Design to turn customer problems into practical technical solutions.
  • Investigate production problems using logs, monitoring, and data.
  • Write tests, review code, and improve the structure and maintainability of the monorepo.
  • Write down important technical decisions and keep the relevant product and engineering specs current.
  • Help other engineers grow through thoughtful reviews, pairing, and mentoring.
  • TypeScript and Node.js
  • React
  • GraphQL
  • PostgreSQL and pgvector
  • Vitest and Playwright
  • Hasura
  • NX monorepo
  • Temporal
  • AWS and Terraform
  • Datadog and PostHog

What success looks like

In your first few months, you will ship meaningful work across the backend and frontend, learn the main product domains, and become comfortable with our data and permission model.

Over time, you will become a trusted owner of an important part of the platform. You will be able to shape technical work, make sound tradeoffs, handle production issues, and raise the quality of the engineers around you.

What we offer

  • Be part of an early-stage company where you work on topics that matter and your ideas can turn into reality
  • Remote-first, work from everywhere culture
  • Choose your equipment
  • Regular team events
  • Opportunity to learn and develop further

title: 메디컬팀 학술담당 팀원 계약직 (~10/01)
description:
"당신의 성장이 대웅의 목표입니다"

대웅은 직원의 성장을 최우선으로 하며, 자율적으로 몰입하며 일할 수 있는 환경을 제공합니다.
나이/연차/성별/국적 상관없이 역량과 성과를 기반으로
공정/객관/투명하게 평가하고 합리적으로 보상하여 직원이 주인되는 회사를 만들어갑니다.
우리는 직원의 성장이 고객과 사회의 성장으로 이어질 수 있어야 (WIN-WIN-WIN)
비로소 우리의 일이 의미 있다고 믿습니다.
당신이 성장할 수 있는 모든 기회가 있는 곳, 대웅과 함께 성장할 여러분의 도전을 기다립니다.

[조직소개]

학술팀의 목표는 지속적으로 우리 제품의 가치를 높일 수 있는 학술적 명분(근거) 제공을 통해 고객의 신뢰도를 높이는 것입니다.
팀원 별로 담당 약효군을 지정하여 해당 질환, 치료약제, 가이드라인 등에 정통한 전문가로 성장할 수 있으며,

주도적이고 차별화된 방식으로 영업부 역량강화 및 학술자료 제작을 통해 목표달성에 기여하고 학술 전문가로 성장할 수 있습니다.

[담당업무]

1. 자사와 보건의료전문가 사이의 주요 인터페이스 역할을 하며 근거 중심의 의약학 정보를 제공 합니다.
① 국내 의료인에 대한 심층적이고 진보된 질병 및 제품에 대한 전문지식과 과학적 근거 제공
② 과학/의료 전문가와의 상호작용, 의료회의 참석 및 기타 방법을 통해 확인한 과학적 지식과 임상적 통찰력을 수집 및 전달

2. 제품의 가치를 전달할 수 있는 영향력 있는 학술 자료를 제작하고 관리 합니다.
① 객관적이고 최신의 학술 정보를 기반으로 우리 제품의 효과와 안전성을 뒷받침 할 수 있는 자료 수집/제시
② 명확한 키메세지를 포함하고 환자 관리에 도움될 수 있는 학술 자료 제작
③ 약사법과 의약품 정보제공 가이드라인을 준수하도록 학술자료 감수 및 관리

[자걱요건]
1. (한)약학, 간호학, 생명과학, 화학 및 유사 전공 졸업자
2. 제약/의료기기 회사 등 관련 경력 1년 이상
3. 의약품 광고 심의 규정에 대한 이해를 보유하신 분


[우대사항]
1. 학술/판촉자료 제작 or 검토 경력 보유하신 분

[전형안내]

서류접수 > 인적성검사 > 1차면접 > 2차면접 > 처우협의 > 채용검진 > 최종입사

⠀*⠀면접 전형 후 필요 시 평판조회가 진행될 수 있습니다.

⠀*⠀전형 절차는 변경될 수 있으며, 변경 시 별도 안내 예정입니다.

⠀

[기타사항]

- 해당 공고는 계약직 (1년) 채용 공고인 점 안내드립니다. (면접전형 이후 계약기간 조율 예정입니다.)

- 입사 후 12주 간 수습기간이 적용됩니다.
- 공고는 전형 진행 상황에 따라 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
- 국가보훈대상자 및 장애인은 우대하여 채용합니다.
- 기타 문의사항은 <dw_career@daewoong.co.kr> 으로 문의해주시기 바랍니다.
- 지원서에 허위사실이 있을 경우 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.

title: Sr Admin Applications Ops
description:
We are seeking a Senior Admin Application Operations to join American Tower’s Information Technology (“IT”) organization. This role serves as a senior-level administrator and technical lead responsible for the end-to-end administration, stability, and operational maturity of application platforms supporting middleware, custom applications and integrations (e.g., MuleSoft, Tomcat, WebLogic, ODI[TY1] ) within a global operating model. This role expands beyond execution to include platform-level ownership, standardization, and continuous improvement, with accountability for environment strategy, configuration integrity, deployment reliability, and operational governance. The Senior Analyst partners closely with engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, and architecture teams to ensure applications are operable by design, resilient, and scalable. You will lead efforts in advancing continuous delivery/deployment (“CI/CD”) pipelines, automation frameworks, and DevOps practices, while ensuring consistent adoption of ITIL[TY2] -aligned processes (change, configuration, release, and problem management). This role plays a key part in improving platform reliability, reducing operational risk, and driving automation-led efficiency across environments.

• Lead and standardize platform administration practices across applications, defining operational patterns and improving consistency and operational readiness across environments.
• Define and enforce configuration management standards, ensuring integrity, consistency, and auditability of application environments across development, test, and production.
• Design and standardize CI/CD pipelines, establishing best practices for automated deployments and environment orchestration and release standardization.
• Architect and implement automation frameworks to eliminate manual processes and improve deployment and operational efficiency at scale.
• Manage and govern complex deployments, upgrades, and patching activities, including release planning, sequencing, rollback strategies, and validation of production readiness.
• Provide leadership over environment health, performance, and integration stability, driving proactive risk mitigation and ensuring operability, automation, and observability are embedded across application design and
delivery.
• Lead advanced troubleshooting of platform, configuration, and integration issues, leveraging deep expertise in logs, data flows, and system architecture.
• Drive systemic root cause elimination and implement structural improvements to prevent recurring platform issues.
• Act as a key contributor to DevOps and operational maturity initiatives, influencing best practices for environment management, observability, automation, and release engineering.
• Define and enhance monitoring, alerting, and observability practices to improve visibility into platform health, performance, and integration stability.
• Continuously improve and optimize ITIL-aligned processes to enhance operational efficiency and risk management.
• Collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to ensure operability, scalability, and supportability are embedded into system design and delivery pipelines.
• Maintain and continuously evolve operational standards and documentation, including runbooks, configuration baselines, deployment models, and automation frameworks.
• Mentor and guide Associate and Base-level analysts, providing technical leadership and promoting consistent administrative standards and best practices.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance platform stability, reduce operational overhead, and standardize administration practices across the organization.
• Other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• 5+ years of experience in application administration, middleware platform operations, or DevOps-oriented roles.

• Proven expertise in middleware platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Tomcat, WebLogic and ODI) and strong understanding of application integrations and distributed system architectures.
• Demonstrated experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release engineering practices.
• Hands-on experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Shell, Python, PowerShell, or similar) to optimize platform operations and reduce manual effort.
• Strong understanding and practical application of ITIL frameworks, including change management, configuration management, release management, and problem management.
• Demonstrated ability to own platform stability and drive root cause elimination, with a proactive and prevention-focused operational mindset.
• Experience operating in complex enterprise environments with multiple applications, integrations, and dependencies.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex cross-system and configuration issues.
• Ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, DevOps, architecture) to drive operational improvements and standards.
• Strong communication and documentation skills in English, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts, operational standards, and governance practices.

title: Multilingual Community Health Coordinator
description:
Building Name: UVMMC - 40 IDX Drive

Location Address: 40 IDX Drive, South Burlington Vermont

Regular

Department: Community Health Strategy and Impact

Full Time

Standard Hours: 40

Biweekly Scheduled Hours: 80

Shift: Day

Primary Shift: 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM

Weekend Needs: Other

Salary Range: Min $27.85 Mid $34.82 Max $41.78

Recruiter: Kate Davies

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Multilingual Community Health Coordinator builds trusted relationships with multilingual individuals, families, and communities and helps them navigate health care and social-service systems across UVM Health’s service area in Vermont and Northern New York. The position provides culturally and linguistically responsive outreach, education, advocacy, resource connection, and follow-up to help address language, financial, transportation, digital, and other nonclinical barriers to care.

The Multilingual Community Health Coordinator also co-chairs the Multilingual Patient and Family Advisory Council, helping ensure multilingual patient and family perspectives inform service improvement, community health planning, and organizational decision making. Serving as a bridge among communities, UVM Health teams, and community-based organizations, the Multilingual Community Health Coordinator helps individuals access appropriate services, provides warm handoffs to health and social resources, and connects patients and families with qualified interpreter services and translated materials. The position communicates directly in languages in which the employee has demonstrated proficiency for routine outreach, education, and navigation but does not provide medical interpretation or independently translate regulated materials unless separately qualified and authorized.

The Multilingual Community Health Coordinator also identifies recurring community needs and access barriers, shares community feedback with appropriate teams, and supports Community Health Needs Assessment and Community Health Improvement Plan priorities affecting multilingual communities. The position reports to the Community Health Improvement Manager and works in alignment with UVM Health’s broader community health improvement and health equity priorities.

EDUCATION:

Associate degree or additional education in community health, public health, human services, social services, education, or a related field preferred. Relevant lived, community-based, or professional experience may be considered in place of preferred formal education.

Certification and Training:

  • Community Health Worker certification or completion of a recognized Community Health Worker training program preferred.

  • If not certified at the time of hire, completion of an approved Community Health Worker training or certification program within an established timeframe may be required.

  • Additional training in health equity, cultural humility, motivational interviewing, health literacy, language access, trauma-informed practices, or care navigation preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience working with multilingual, immigrant, refugee, or culturally diverse individuals and communities required.

  • Experience in community outreach, health education, advocacy, navigation, healthcare access, human services, public health, or a related field preferred.

  • Experience building trusted relationships with community members and community-based organizations preferred.

  • Experience helping individuals access healthcare, social services, public benefits, or other community resources preferred.

  • Lived experience or a demonstrated connection to one or more of the communities served strongly preferred.

  • Experience working collaboratively with healthcare teams, interpreters, community organizations, or public agencies preferred.

  • Fluency in English and at least one additional language commonly spoken by the communities served strongly preferred.

description:
ABOUT AEROFARMS

AeroFarms is transforming agriculture with people and the planet in mind. As a Certified B Corporation and a pioneer in indoor vertical farming, we have built a proprietary agriculture platform to grow products delivering superior flavor, better quality, and improved nutrition and food safety in our industry.
Join AeroFarms at our advanced indoor farming and automated packaging facility in Danville, VA as an Automation & Continuous Improvement Engineer. This role will drive automation performance, packaging efficiency, and mechanical innovation across the facility while working closely with operations and engineering teams to continuously improve production systems.

Position Overview

The Automation & Continuous Improvement Engineer is responsible for improving the performance, reliability, and scalability of automated systems across AeroFarms’ production and packaging operations.
This role combines automation engineering, mechanical design, and manufacturing process optimization to drive measurable improvements in throughput, quality, and operational efficiency.
The ideal candidate thrives in a hands-on manufacturing environment, enjoys solving complex production challenges, and is motivated by building and improving real-world systems.

Key Responsibilities – Manufacturing Automation & Process Optimization

• Identify and implement improvements to automated production and packaging systems to increase throughput and reduce downtime.
• Analyze production data to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies.
• Implement automation improvements that improve equipment uptime, product flow, and labor efficiency.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and root cause analysis.

Packaging Systems Engineering

• Improve the performance of automated packaging lines including weighing systems, conveyors, labeling equipment, and product handling systems.
• Optimize line balance and material flow to reduce operational bottlenecks.
• Reduce product giveaway and improve packaging accuracy through process improvements and automation modifications.
• Support the design and integration of new packaging technologies and equipment.

Mechanical Design & Equipment Innovation

• Design mechanical improvements and custom components to enhance equipment performance.
• Develop fixtures, brackets, guards, and tooling to support automation improvements.
• Work with fabrication teams or vendors to implement equipment modifications.
• Prototype and test equipment upgrades to improve reliability and efficiency.

Automation & Controls Engineering

• Support and modify PLC-controlled automation systems across the facility.
• Troubleshoot and optimize robotics, motion systems, and automated work cells.
• Modify PLC logic to support new processes, equipment upgrades, and production improvements.
• Support commissioning and integration of new automated equipment.

Equipment Reliability & Performance

• Investigate recurring equipment issues and lead root cause analysis.
• Implement engineering improvements that reduce equipment failures and improve system robustness.
• Develop engineering solutions that improve maintainability and reliability of automated systems.

Cross-Functional Engineering Collaboration

• Partner with operations, maintenance, agronomy, and engineering teams to solve production challenges.
• Work with external integrators, vendors, and equipment manufacturers to develop system improvements.
• Support capital improvement projects and equipment upgrades.

Safety, Compliance & Documentation

• Ensure all equipment modifications meet machine safety, electrical safety, and food manufacturing standards.
• Maintain documentation and change management records for automation and equipment improvements.

Technical Scope

• PLC platforms (Allen-Bradley ControlLogix, Siemens, Schneider, Wago)
• Automated packaging systems
• Conveyance and product handling equipment
• Servo and stepper motion control systems
• Robotic work cells
• Industrial sensors and instrumentation
• Weigh scales and labeling systems
• Pumps, valves, motors, and environmental control equipment

Qualifications

Required:
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or Mechatronics
• 3+ years of experience in highly automated manufacturing or packaging environments
OR
• Associate’s degree in Automation, Mechatronics, or related field and 7–10 years of industrial automation experience

Preferred:
• Experience in high-speed packaging or automated manufacturing
• Experience with mechanical design or equipment fabrication
• Experience working in food manufacturing or regulated industries
• Experience with robotics or motion control systems

Skills & Competencies
• Strong mechanical and automation troubleshooting ability
• Ability to design and implement practical engineering solutions
• Hands-on approach to solving manufacturing challenges
• Experience analyzing production systems and identifying improvements
• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills
• Ability to translate operational problems into engineering solutions
• Curiosity and drive to continuously improve systems

Summary of Benefits:
Base salary range is $100,000–$130,000 annually, annual company/performance bonus, eligible for equity, matching 401k with no vesting period, 4+ weeks of vacation/sick time/PTO, group health plan including medical, dental, vision etc.

In accordance with organizational protocol, employees will at times be required to fill absences in the operation process that are equal to or lower than their positional hierarchy. Additionally, if an employee is absent, the role of the absent employee is to be completed by their immediate superior.

Internal candidates seeking a promotion must have completed a minimum of six months in their current role and/or have less than four attendance points, with no corrective actions before becoming eligible for consideration.

title: Vocational Evaluator
description:
Job Title: Vocational Evaluator
Department: Disability Services
Reports to: Director of Vocational Rehabilitation Services
Location: Montclair & East Orange, New Jersey, with community travel as needed
Salary: $55,000 - $60,000

Job Overview
The Vocational Evaluator conducts comprehensive vocational evaluations for individuals with disabilities and other barriers to employment. Using interviews, standardized assessments, work samples, observations, and other appropriate evaluation methods, the evaluator identifies participants’ strengths, interests, abilities, employment preferences, support needs, and potential barriers to employment.
The Vocational Evaluator develops objective, individualized recommendations for employment, training, accommodations, supportive services, and vocational rehabilitation services; prepares timely evaluation reports; and collaborates with participants, NJDVRS counselors, schools, community partners, and the JVS service team. This is a grant-funded position.
Key Responsibilities
  • Conduct comprehensive vocational evaluations using interviews, standardized assessments, interest and aptitude measures, academic assessments, work samples, situational observations, and other appropriate evaluation tools.
  • Assess participants’ vocational interests, skills, abilities, work behaviors, functional capabilities, employment preferences, transferable skills, support needs, and barriers to employment.
  • Provide reasonable accommodations and modify evaluation methods as appropriate to ensure assessments are accessible and responsive to individual needs.
  • Observe and document participant performance, including attendance, punctuality, productivity, task comprehension, work quality, interpersonal skills, communication, response to supervision, and ability to learn new tasks.
  • Incorporate participant choice, informed decision-making, cultural considerations, and individual preferences throughout the evaluation process.
  • Use current labor-market information to evaluate occupational goals and identify appropriate employment opportunities, career pathways, training programs, accommodations, and supportive services.
  • Conduct community-based or situational vocational assessments when authorized and appropriate.
  • Prepare comprehensive evaluation reports summarizing assessment results, observations, participant input, vocational implications, and individualized recommendations.
  • Complete evaluation reports and submit required documentation to referral sources within contractual timelines, generally within two weeks of completing the evaluation unless otherwise specified.
  • Ensure recommendations are objective, supported by evaluation findings, and responsive to the referral questions and participant’s vocational goals.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, timely, and confidential participant records in SetWorks and other required systems, including participant contacts, assessments, accommodations, case consultations, services, and outcomes.
  • Maintain assessment protocols, scoring records, consent forms, authorizations, reports, testing materials, and related documentation in accordance with JVS confidentiality, security, and record-retention requirements.
  • Track evaluation authorizations and due dates and promptly communicate circumstances that may affect timely completion of services or reports.
  • Collaborate with referral sources, schools, rehabilitation professionals, JVS staff, and community partners to coordinate referrals, services, resources, and participant supports.
  • Provide vocational guidance based on evaluation findings to assist participants in identifying realistic employment and training goals.
  • Assist with grant and program reporting, including service data, progress updates, and outcome metrics.
  • Participate in fee-for-service activities and other program initiatives supporting successful employment outcomes.
  • Maintain knowledge of vocational evaluation practices, applicable regulations, contractual requirements, and professional standards through ongoing training and professional development.
  • Perform other duties consistent with program and organizational needs.
Qualifications
  • Master’s degree in rehabilitation counseling, vocational evaluation, counseling, psychology, special education, social work, or a related field.
  • Experience conducting vocational assessments or evaluations and working with individuals with disabilities.
  • Knowledge of vocational assessment instruments, evaluation methodologies, career development, and vocational rehabilitation practices.
  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to prepare clear, objective, and comprehensive evaluation reports.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with participants, NJDVRS counselors, schools, community organizations, and other professionals.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple evaluations and meet required documentation deadlines.
  • Ability to maintain confidential records and comply with applicable program, funding, and regulatory requirements.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to JVS, community, school, and other evaluation locations as required.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Certified Rehabilitation Counselor (CRC), Certified Vocational Evaluation Specialist (CVE), or another relevant professional credential.

JVS of Metrowest is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer committed to excellence. Employment offers are made on the basis of qualifications and without regard to race, sex, religion, national or ethnic origin, disability, age veteran status, or sexual orientation or other protected classes under the State and Federal law.
