title: Director, UI/UX Design
description:
Who we are

At WELLSTAR, we are committed to reshaping Canadian healthcare by leveraging technology to address the administrative burdens that pull physicians away from their true calling—patient care. Our mission is to support providers and patients, shifting the emphasis back to quality, timeliness, and positive outcomes. With a comprehensive suite of technology solutions, we have successfully helped thousands of providers adopt and benefit from modern, interoperable technologies that improve patient outcomes and system efficiency.

Whether you are in research and development, administration, communications, operations leadership, or technology, joining us now is an opportunity to play a critical role in transforming how healthcare is managed and experienced in Canada.

The opportunity

WELLSTAR, a majority-owned subsidiary of WELL Health Technologies Corp, is a high-growth SaaS company with a focused objective of reshaping healthcare through digital enablement. Our innovative solutions are designed to streamline care delivery, integrate healthcare systems and improve patient outcomes.

Reporting to the VP, Product Management, we are hiring a Director, UI/UX Design to lead the design function for the Clinical Platform Group. As our new Director, UI/UX Design, you will lead and develop an established team of designers while owning the quality, consistency, and evolution of the end-to-end product experience. You will set the design direction for a modern, AI-first EMR platform, strengthen user research and design practices, and ensure the needs of clinicians remain central to how the product evolves. Working as a peer to Product and Engineering leadership, you will bring greater structure and consistency to how teams collaborate from problem definition and discovery through design, development, and release.

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada, with occasional travel for team on-sites and clinic visits.

What’s in it for you

Leadership and influence. You will step into an established design team with the opportunity to make a strong team even better. You will have the scope to develop designers, raise the bar on craft and consistency, and shape how the design function evolves as the product and organization grow. Working alongside Product and Engineering leadership, you will have a voice in decisions that influence both the product experience and how teams work together.

Shape an AI-first healthcare experience. You will help define how clinicians interact with AI in a product they rely on to deliver care. From how AI-generated suggestions are presented to how confidence, transparency, and clinician control are built into the experience, you will influence some of the most important design questions facing Nexus AI EMR as the platform evolves.

Build better ways of working. You will have the opportunity to strengthen and mature an existing design practice rather than build one from the ground up. You will refine research, design processes, cross-functional collaboration, and the design system, creating the structure that helps designers do their best work and enables Product, Design, and Engineering to move forward together.

What you will do:

  • Lead and develop the design team. You will coach and support an established team of designers, creating clear ownership, providing meaningful feedback, and helping each person build on their strengths and grow. You will foster a collaborative critique culture and create the conditions for the team to consistently deliver high-quality work.
  • Own the end-to-end product experience. You will be accountable for the quality, consistency, and coherence of the Clinical Platform Group product experience across clinical and administrative workflows. You will establish and uphold a high design standard, incorporating accessibility and clinical safety considerations into how experiences are designed and delivered.
  • Shape AI-assisted experiences. You will set the design direction for how AI is integrated into clinical workflows, including how suggestions are surfaced, confidence and provenance are communicated, and clinicians remain in control. You will help ensure AI-enabled experiences are practical, intuitive, and designed around the realities of clinical care.
  • Strengthen how Design, Product, and Engineering work together. You will partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to bring design into problem definition, discovery, refinement, and delivery. You will improve handoffs and feedback loops so requirements, designs, edge cases, and intended experiences are clearly understood and carried through to what is released.
  • Evolve design practices and systems. You will refine the design process from intake and discovery through critique, handoff, and design QA, keeping it structured without creating unnecessary complexity. You will champion the design system, patterns, documentation, and tools that help the team work efficiently and deliver a consistent experience.
  • Bring users closer to product decisions. You will establish a sustainable approach to user research, including interviews and engagement with clinics, and ensure insights are shared effectively across Design, Product, and Engineering. You will help turn what the team learns from clinicians and customers into meaningful improvements to the product and roadmap.

What you bring:

  • The design leadership experience. You have experience leading and developing product designers, including coaching, providing meaningful feedback, supporting career development, and managing performance. You know how to assess the strengths of an established team, build trust, and create the clarity and support people need to do their best work.
  • The product design expertise. You have designed and shipped complex, workflow-heavy software where usability, accuracy, and attention to detail matter. You bring strong design judgment and can critically evaluate work, challenge assumptions, and raise the quality and consistency of the user experience without imposing a rigid design philosophy.
  • The ability to evolve a design practice. You have improved how a design team operates, whether through stronger discovery and research practices, critique and review, design systems, handoffs, or design QA. You can introduce structure without unnecessary process and understand how to measure whether changes are making the team and the product better.
  • The cross-functional approach. You have worked closely with Product and Engineering teams in an agile product environment and understand how design fits into discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, development, and release. You can influence peers and senior stakeholders, communicate design decisions and trade-offs clearly, and build alignment around the user experience.
  • The curiosity for AI-enabled design. You are comfortable exploring AI-assisted design tools and bring a thoughtful perspective on where they can improve speed and effectiveness without compromising craft or consistency. Experience designing AI or LLM-powered products, including human-in-the-loop experiences, would be an asset.
  • The adaptability. You design for the needs of the people using the product rather than following a single definition of what good UX should look like. You can work with complex, information-dense experiences and balance user needs, accessibility, technical constraints, and the realities of the environment in which the product is used. Experience in healthcare, EMR/EHR products, or another regulated environment is an asset.

Why join us?

WELLSTAR is a leading healthcare technology company dedicated to reshaping healthcare through digital enablement. We provide a comprehensive, holistic solution for healthcare providers across Canada, with over 40% of practitioners currently using our products and services. Our solutions serve primary care physicians, specialist physicians, health systems, and public sector organizations through a comprehensive suite that includes billing and practice management systems, electronic medical records (EMRs), digital health applications, and digital health network solutions.

As a majority-owned subsidiary of WELL Health, WELLSTAR continues to drive innovation and transformation in the Canadian healthcare landscape, reducing administrative burden and empowering providers to deliver better patient outcomes through advanced technology solutions.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the VP, Product Management focused on your design leadership experience, approach to developing and supporting a design team, and experience strengthening collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering.
  • A final interview with the team focused on team dynamics, collaboration and how you would contribute to the broader team.


Compensation

The salary range for this position is $120-150K. The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At WELLSTAR, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

Apply now.

Interested in applying but worried you don't have it all? At WELLSTAR, we know not everyone gains their experience following a traditional path. If you share our values, want to make a difference in healthcare technology solutions, and meet 70% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Express your interest here.

WELLSTAR is committed to supporting a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome and celebrate the diversity of applicants and team members across ability, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, and perspective. We strive to create an inclusive workplace where differences are celebrated and fuel our success. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Vice President of Servicing & Collections
description:
About DigniFi:
DigniFi’s Point-of-Sale financing solution helps 2,000+ partners increase revenue, drive accessory orders, and decrease deferred repairs. We partner with dealerships and service centers to offer financing products at the point of sale for auto repairs, service, parts, accessories, maintenance packages, and more.

About The Role:
The Vice President of Servicing & Collections is accountable for strategy, operating performance, controls, and customer outcomes across the post-origination lifecycle, from account onboarding through payoff, charge-off, or recovery. Reporting to the Chief Credit Risk Officer, this leader directs servicing, collections, recovery, quality, workforce, and operating-change priorities; develops leaders and scalable capabilities; and partners with Credit/Risk, Finance, Product/Technology, Operations, Compliance, and Legal to deliver sustainable portfolio performance and fair, consistent customer treatment.

Strategy and Executive Accountability:
  • Own the end-to-end Servicing and Collections strategy, from account onboarding through payoff, charge-off, or recovery, aligned with the company's approved risk appetite, customer commitments, financial plan, and regulatory obligations.
  • Translate strategy into measurable objectives, operating priorities, resource requirements, and a sequenced change roadmap with clear decision rights and accountable owners.
  • Provide the CCRO and executive leadership with decision-quality reporting on portfolio trends, customer outcomes, operating performance, capacity, emerging risks, and material exceptions; recommend actions and escalate matters outside delegated authority.

Servicing Operations and Customer Outcomes:
  • Be accountable for the accurate and timely execution of the account-servicing lifecycle in partnership with the Operations team, including account setup, payment processing, account maintenance, statements and notices, adjustments, disputes, accommodations, payoff, credit furnishing, and account closure, as applicable.
  • Establish service levels, capacity standards, queue and backlog thresholds, handoff requirements, and escalation triggers that support timely service, operational accuracy, and appropriate customer outcomes.
  • Own the Servicing and Collections customer-escalation process; ensure complaints and customer-harm indicators are analyzed for root causes and that durable corrective actions and required customer remediation are completed.

Collections and Recovery Strategy:
  • Design and govern collections and recovery strategy from early delinquency through default, charge-off, and post-charge-off recovery, including segmentation, treatment paths, contact channels, placement strategy, and escalation criteria.
  • Establish business policies and delegated authorities for payment arrangements, hardship assistance, fee waivers, settlements, loss-mitigation options, and pre-legal or legal referral, subject to approved risk appetite and Legal and Compliance guidance.
  • Approve material changes to treatment strategies, dialer and list rules, scripts, communication templates, and decisioning logic through documented change control, required approvals, testing, operational readiness, and post-implementation monitoring.
  • Optimize customer resolution and portfolio outcomes using balanced measures such as cure rates, roll rates, kept promises, recoveries, losses, cost to collect, complaints, quality, and customer-harm indicators; sponsor controlled experimentation and act on results.

Risk, Compliance, Controls, and Quality:
  • Serve as the first-line business owner for compliant execution within Servicing and Collections. Partner with Compliance and Legal for interpretation, required approvals, monitoring, and independent challenge, and ensure the business implements approved requirements.
  • Establish a risk-based quality-assurance and monitoring framework covering customer interactions, including sampling, calibration, critical-error standards, and verified remediation closure.
  • Promptly identify, escalate, contain, and remediate control failures, operational incidents, customer harm, audit or examination findings, and repeat issues; maintain complete records supporting decisions, approvals, testing, and sustainable closure.

Performance, Economics, and Management Information:
  • Govern KPI definitions, data quality, dashboards, forecasts, and scorecards to provide a consistent and authoritative view of performance from account onboarding through recovery.
  • Own the department's operating plan, budget, workforce-capacity model, and vendor-spend plan; partner with Credit/Risk, Finance, and Analytics on portfolio, loss, and recovery forecasts and corrective actions for material variances.

Technology, Third Parties, and Operational Resilience:
  • Serve as the business owner for Servicing and Collections technology and automation, including requirements, prioritization, user acceptance testing, operational readiness, control requirements, implementation, and post-launch performance.
  • Define and monitor the service, quality, control, reporting, and continuity requirements for third parties supporting Servicing and Collections; drive issue remediation while partnering with the COO organization, Procurement, Compliance, and Legal on due diligence, contracting, onboarding, oversight, and termination responsibilities.
  • Maintain effective business-continuity, incident-response, manual-fallback, and backup-ownership arrangements for critical Servicing and Collections processes.

Organization and Leadership Capability:
  • Design and maintain a scalable organization and workforce model, including roles, spans of control, staffing levels, scheduling, capacity, and backup coverage appropriate to portfolio volume, complexity, service commitments, and risk.
  • Build a strong leadership bench and succession pipeline; establish balanced performance and incentive expectations and ensure onboarding, refresher, and change-driven training are measured for demonstrated effectiveness

Who You Are:
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Operations, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in loan servicing, collections, and/or recovery operations (consumer lending preferred).
  • Demonstrated success leading operating cadence and cross‑functional execution in a KPI‑driven environment.
  • Working knowledge of collections/servicing regulatory considerations (e.g., FDCPA, TCPA) sufficient to partner effectively with Compliance & Legal; does not replace legal interpretation.
  • Experience managing vendor and tooling performance (dialers, agencies, letter vendors, skip tracing, analytics/BI) and driving escalations to closure.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to translate data into strategy direction and operational action.
  • Exceptional communication skills (written and verbal) and comfort presenting to senior leadership.
  • People leadership experience (hiring, developing leaders, performance management, and coaching).
  • Proficiency with modern collections/servicing systems and reporting tools (e.g., Five9, Peach, Tableau, Excel).

Why You’ll Love Working at DigniFi:
  • High-growth opportunity with terrific upside potential.
  • Founded to provide aid to people when they unexpectedly need help...responsible, respectful, and transparent access to a better financial future for our customers.
  • Excellence-driven organization that values work/life balance.
  • We’re a tight-knit team that values collaboration and genuinely loves working together.

What’s In It for You:
  • Flexible PTO
  • 12 Paid Holidays
  • Up to 80% Employer-Paid Premiums for Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Long-term Disability Insurance
  • Basic Life Insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Matching 401k

Where You Will Work:
This position is located in our Irving Office.

In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our company. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DigniFi.

title: Security and Loss Prevention Expert, Worldwide Operations Security
description:
The Security and Loss Prevention Expert (SLP Expert) is a key leadership position within the Amazon Security and Loss Prevention (S&LP) team. This role leads the effort to efficiently and effectively provide End-to-End (E2E) S&LP services across all assigned operational business units. This position reports to the Security and Loss Prevention Cluster Manager.

Key job responsibilities
- Identify vulnerabilities and conduct root cause analysis using data to define mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards.
- Actively monitor and report outcome for systems and tools that generate data indicating site/region opportunities.
- Manage confidential investigations and prepare prompt reports of theft, fraud, and workplace violence/critical incidents.
- Utilize continuous improvement to drive process enhancements and increase efficiency.
- Serve as department’s liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert keeping site leadership informed on department’s key issues, strategies and the performance.
- Identify, promote and implement security best practices while effectively partnering with internal customers to evaluate current and future security needs, processes, and initiatives, incident response planning, facilitating and management.
- Domestic regional travel up to 50% of the time when applicable.
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
- This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

A day in the life
As a SLP Expert, you will join a team of S&LP professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events.

During your investigations, you will collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in various processes to identify and drive mitigating measures.

You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience.

You will be working on multiple high-impact initiatives/projects by collaborating with stakeholders across organizational levels to deliver measurable outcomes through effective project management.

Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our S&LP plan.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon’s Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection.

We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

title: Senior C++ Software Engineer – Real Time Trading
description:
At Wolverine Trading, we're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer to build and optimize the market data and execution systems at the heart of our trading operation. This role is on-site in our Chicago headquarters, where engineers work shoulder-to-shoulder with traders and hardware specialists on systems where every microsecond counts. You'll take on some of the most technically demanding problems in the industry including processing enormous volumes of market data, connecting exchanges around the world, and executing orders at maximum speed and reliability. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who thrives on performance-critical work, wants their code running in production where its impact is immediately measurable, and is ready to help set the technical direction of a growing team.
  • Build and enhance low-latency C++ components for market data processing, exchange connectivity, and order execution.
  • Develop and optimize connectivity to new markets and exchange platforms, expanding the reach of our trading business.
  • Analyze and tune system performance at every level from application code and lock-free data structures to network and OS-level behavior.
  • Collaborate with traders, FPGA engineers, and infrastructure teams to deliver end-to-end solutions across software and hardware.
  • Own production systems through the full lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and real-time support.
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of professional experience developing C++ code; exposure to low-latency, real-time, or high-throughput systems from any industry is a plus.
  • Expert-level knowledge of modern C++ (C++17 or later), including templates, move semantics, and low-level performance idioms.
  • Strong grasp of systems fundamentals: memory hierarchies, CPU architecture, lock-free programming, and network protocols (TCP/UDP).
  • No prior trading or financial markets experience needed! We are looking for a strong technical foundation and a drive to learn the domain is what matters.
  • A pragmatic, detail-oriented approach and communication skills to work effectively with both technical and trading teams.
Our flat organizational structure promotes teamwork across the Firm and offers easy access to senior staff. While we work exceptionally well as a team in the office, our bonds are further strengthened through company events, activities and giving back. Volleyball, soccer, hockey, 5K runs, picnic, parties, and trivia nights provide friendly competition and build better relationships. By getting out of our usual environment and doing out-of-the-ordinary things together, we foster creativity and broaden our imaginations to accomplish new challenges.

title: Traffic Management Operative
description:
As an experienced Traffic Management Operative, you will be required to work on Traffic Management Schemes for a range of projects, helping them to run smoothly and efficiently to achieve maximum production in a working day, whilst maintaining a high Health and Safety standard. This role requires flexibility due to the nature of the business. You must be able to work both days and nights, including some weekends as required. You must have a can do and responsible attitude to work.

Direct and Self Employed available
We are looking for someone to:
  • Oversee all methods of traffic management; Give and take, Priority, Stop/Go boards, Portable traffic signals, Convoy working, Road closures, Lane closures and diversions
  • Ensure all work is carried out according to safe working methods and best practice procedures
  • Carry out risk assessments and method statements on works involving traffic management
  • Ensure that all activities associated with the job are carried out according to laid down procedures where possible. Identify areas that can be improved and report to your line manager
  • Ensure that daily vehicle checks are carried out – to ensure cleanliness and tidiness of vehicle and the safety of the driver and passenger
  • Promote positive company image whilst at work (via wearing of company clothing, attitude, and site cleanliness)
  • Demonstrate initiative by constantly looking to see where improvements can be made
  • Assist the public, directing them through safe site lines when required
  • Ascertain when management intervention is required
GTM Golden Rules to be followed
  • Only undertake Traffic Management activities that you have the qualification to undertake (LANTRA)
  • All Traffic Management setups must be compliant with guidance and legislation (Red Book, Chapter 8, ARTSM etc.)
  • Regularly check your site to ensure it remains compliant
  • Report any unsafe acts and conditions, and rectify immediately if safe and competent to do so

description:
BOARD CERTIFIED BEHAVIOR ANALYST (BCBA)

Field-Based - Spring, TX

Join Butterfly Effects for Impactful ABA Careers in Autism Therapy

We are looking for passionate a BCBA to help us fulfill our mission to make a socially meaningful change in the lives of children and families. We want you to enjoy coming to work, so we dedicate and commit ourselves to making our teams feel valued, respected, and heard.

This isn't just another place to work, it's a welcoming environment with a leadership team that champions every individual to achieve their potential.

What would you be doing?

You will be integral to ensuring the highest possible treatment outcomes for families affected by ASD. As a member of the Butterfly Effects Interdisciplinary Team, the BCBA designs and manages individualized behavior programming including:

  • Supervising direct 1:1 treatment service, developing individualized goals/objectives
  • Conducting behavior assessments
  • Individualizing client treatment plans
  • Managing RBTs/ BTs
  • Conducting monthly caregiver training

Why Work at Butterfly Effects?

  • Customized compensation packages based on the needs of the applicant
  • Benefit packages, including:
    • Medical, Dental, & Vision coverage
    • Life Insurance and Supplemental Insurance programs
    • PTO and Holidays
    • 401K

  • Mentorship with an experienced BCBA for newly certified BCBAs to help you develop your skill set
  • Company issued laptop
  • Participation in work groups, research projects, and activities to expand the company culture and spread community awareness
  • Supportive work setting designed to develop staff in a positive employee culture
  • Flexible schedule for Field BCBAs

What do you bring to the role?

  • Master's degree in Applied Behavior Analysis or related field.
  • BCBA Certification - Must hold a current certification by the BACB.
  • BCBAs that require additional experience will be enrolled in our BCBA mentorship program.

Who are we?

Butterfly Effects is an autism-specific ABA-based provider group with home and center-based services in the New Orleans area and across the country. The treatment model is grounded in the implementation science of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), Family-Centered Planning, Routines-Based Intervention, and family participation. BE's treatment philosophy is guided by the belief that services should be provided as early in a child's development as possible, be individualized for each child/family, and support the unique culture of each family. The BE treatment team is led by a BCBA who will engage the family in their child's treatment, coordinate care with other treatment professionals, work with community resources, supervise the behavior technician (BT) implementing the treatment plan, and develop a positive collaborative relationship with any other professionals working with the child and family.

Butterfly Effects has served more than 10,000 families since our inception in 2005. We have a long history of improving the lives of children and families affected by autism spectrum disorder through our family-centric applied behavior analysis (ABA) approach. Our mission is to deliver ABA treatment in partnership with families affected by autism to foster a more joyous life.

Our butterfly logo was chosen as a symbol of love, rebirth, and metamorphosis. Together, the name and logo represent our common purpose and deep commitment to helping families create lasting change through individualized ABA therapy.

title: Construction Serviceman Refrigeration
description:
The Construction Serviceman Refrigeration is a skilled union craftsperson responsible for servicing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and supporting commercial refrigeration systems across new construction and remodel environments. This position performs journeyman-level service work across multiple disciplines—including mechanical refrigeration, electrical diagnostics, pipefitting, and basic carpentry—as required to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable operation of refrigeration equipment. All work must comply with union standards, project specifications, and safety regulations.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Diagnose, service, and repair commercial HVAC/R and refrigeration systems, ensuring proper operation and compliance with engineering specifications.
  • Perform maintenance and repair on refrigerant piping, pumps, compressors, valves (electric and pneumatic), heat‑transfer components, and air‑distribution equipment.
  • Conduct troubleshooting and leak-detection procedures using approved union methods, including electronic leak detectors, pressure gauges, or soap-and-water solutions.
  • Test electrical circuits, sensors, motors, and control components to identify issues and perform necessary repairs or adjustments.
  • Support installation teams by connecting refrigerant line sets, ducts, controls, and related equipment during service-related construction activities.
  • Inspect, calibrate, and maintain refrigeration and EMS (Energy Management Systems) equipment according to job requirements and union service procedures.
  • Provide professional customer service while maintaining high standards of communication, documentation, and jobsite conduct.
  • Follow all required check‑in, check‑out, and reporting procedures with customers, supervisors, and project teams.
  • Ensure strict compliance with all safety, environmental, governmental, and union regulations on every jobsite.
  • Participate in scheduled on‑call rotations to respond to emergency refrigeration service needs that support customer operational requirements.
  • Perform additional service duties as assigned; responsibilities may evolve according to project needs and union scope guidelines.

Skills, Education & Competencies

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, wiring diagrams, and refrigeration system documentation.
  • Skilled in troubleshooting and servicing commercial refrigeration equipment, refrigerant piping, pumps, valves, air-handling units, and heat‑transfer systems.
  • Proficient in diagnostic testing of piping systems, electrical circuits, motors, controls, and refrigeration components.
  • Knowledge of union construction and service practices, safety protocols, and jobsite procedures.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude with the ability to perform physically demanding service work across multiple trades.
  • Commitment to quality workmanship, customer service excellence, and professional jobsite behavior.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Work requires standing, walking, bending, stooping, crawling, climbing, and carrying materials for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift, push, and pull up to 75 lbs.
  • Frequent use of hands, tools, diagnostic instruments, and service equipment; must be able to read fine print, communicate clearly, and complete accurate documentation.
  • Must be able to work in varied conditions including outdoor weather, construction areas, rooftops, mechanical rooms, and uneven terrain.
  • Exposure to loud noise, machinery, and occasional chemicals or hazardous materials common to refrigeration service environments.
  • Variable work hours, including required participation in on‑call rotations per company and union agreements.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be available to support individuals with disabilities in performing essential job functions.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Backend - Billing Team based in Germany.

Join a small, high-impact engineering team building and scaling reliable backend systems for a rapidly growing digital product.
Take ownership of backend features, APIs, services, and business logic that support critical product capabilities.
Work on complex technical challenges while keeping simplicity, reliability, and long-term scalability at the center of engineering decisions.
Contribute across the development lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through testing, code reviews, and production support.
Help strengthen infrastructure resilience and redundancy as systems and workloads continue to scale.
Collaborate closely with experienced engineers and product stakeholders in a flat, entrepreneurial environment.
Have meaningful influence over technical direction and product evolution while working with a modern cloud-native technology stack.

Accountabilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve backend features and services supporting the product.
  • Design and implement robust backend APIs and business logic for both new and existing product capabilities.
  • Build services with a strong focus on simplicity, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and incorporating feedback from other engineers.
  • Design, test, consume, and support APIs for production web services.
  • Contribute to improving the reliability, redundancy, and resilience of production infrastructure.
  • Work across a diverse technology environment and identify opportunities to improve systems, processes, and engineering practices.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities to apply them effectively within the technical environment.
  • Collaborate closely with teammates and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality projects efficiently.
  • Take ownership of technical challenges, analyze problems independently, and drive solutions through to completion.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience in backend software engineering, with expertise in at least one general-purpose programming language.
    • Highly proficient in database design and development, with experience working with both relational and NoSQL databases such as Scylla and Redis.
    • Hands-on experience creating, testing, consuming, and supporting APIs for web services.
    • Comfortable working with AWS, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, and continuous deployment workflows.
    • Ability to work effectively within a multi-language technology stack and adapt to different programming environments.
    • Experience with Node.js and TypeScript or Rust is an advantage, but not required.
    • Basic frontend development knowledge and an understanding of how backend and frontend systems interact.
    • Experience with modern frontend frameworks is a plus.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a technical team.
    • Self-directed and analytical approach, with strong problem-solving abilities and a willingness to take ownership.
    • Entrepreneurial and pragmatic mindset, with the ability to move quickly while maintaining high engineering standards.
    • Comfortable working in small teams where individual contributors have significant responsibility and influence.

      • Benefits:

      • Startup-style environment with a flat organizational structure.
      • Opportunity to work closely with founders and experienced team members.
      • Significant influence over product development and technical evolution.
      • Opportunity to build technology that reaches and impacts a large global audience.
      • Equity package offering an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business.
      • Access to the technology and tools needed to perform effectively.
      • High degree of ownership and autonomy in your work.
      • Collaborative environment where individual contributions have a meaningful impact.
      • Opportunity to work on complex backend, cloud, and infrastructure challenges in a rapidly scaling product environment.

title: EMT ADVANCED (EMT ADV) for LSA
description:
Lone Star Ambulance and Allegiance Mobile Health of McAllen, TX are looking to hire for our EMT ADVANCED (EMT ADV) position.

SUMMARY: Lone Star Ambulance and Allegiance Mobile Health are looking for a compassionate and reliable EMT-Advanced to provide essential pre-hospital care and emergency medical assistance. The EMT-ADV will respond to 911 calls, assess patient conditions, perform basic life support procedures, and assist in patient transport and transfer. This role requires strong communication, a calm demeanor under pressure, and a commitment to patient care.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (Responsibilities include, but not limited to)

· Responds to emergency and non-emergency calls 24 hours per day, drives a variety of emergency vehicles in all road conditions including inclement weather, dense traffic and rural off-road settings.

· Reads map books and follows written and verbal directions in order to respond in an efficient and safe manner.

· Administer drugs such as Albuterol/Ipratropium Bromide Nebulizer Treatment

· Draw up epinephrine for IM injection to treat anaphylaxis

· Start IV's and give fluid infusions, draw blood and give subcutaneous, aerosolized, sublingual, and intranasal medications

· Follows all departmental, local and state driving laws, policies and procedures.

· Uses a variety of communication equipment and appropriately communicates verbally to dispatchers, EMS crews, first responders and other organizations according to departmental policies and procedures.

· Maintains vehicles and equipment in a constant state of readiness and cleanliness.

· Completes daily vehicle and supply checklists and assists with vehicle re-supply, vehicle and equipment decontamination and general readiness-related tasks.

· Immediately reports, in writing, any discrepancies with vehicles, supplies or equipment and their state of readiness.

· Provides direct patient care per Medical Director's authorization and protocols.

· Demonstrates clinical competency in all patient care related instances.

· Demonstrates physical competencies sufficient to allow him/her to lift, carry, transport and extricate patients in all settings, in some cases without assistance.

· Interacts with multiple outside agencies such as Police Departments, Fire Departments and First Responder Organizations. Provides satisfactory customer service and projects professionalism in all contacts.

· Successfully and accurately completes patient care reports, billing information and all other associated documentation in a timely manner.

· Works under physically and psychologically taxing conditions to include inclement weather, temperature extremes, hazardous environments, loud noises and high-stress situations. High potential for exposure to blood-borne pathogens, dangerous chemicals, sharp objects and fall/trip hazards.

· Performs other duties as assigned to include general housekeeping chores and special projects.

· Must successfully pass departmental skills evaluation and fully complete NEOP process before staffing a truck.

· Adhere to company policies and procedures.

· Other duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

· Lift, carry, balance and push up to 125 pounds (250 pounds with assistance).

· Demonstrate flexibility and physical coordination by bending from the waist and touching toes, squat with legs parallel to the ground and kneeling with both knees firmly on the ground.

· Climb 20 sets of stairs without rest within 60 seconds.

· Demonstrate fine manual dexterity by performing job related clinical skills (starting IV's, intubating, etc.).

· Have correctable vision adequate to read street signs, see in low light and read small print.

PSYCHOLOGICAL REQUIREMENTS:

· Use good judgment and remain calm in high-stress situations.

· Maintain a positive attitude in the face of adversity.

· Have good interpersonal and conflict resolution skills.

· Function under situations of extreme fatigue due to little or no rest, extreme temperatures and inclement weather conditions.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

· High school graduate or GED.

· Certified as an EMT in the State of Texas

· CPR certification

· 911 Areas – Pre-Hospital Trauma Life Support (PHTLS) or International Trauma Life Support (ITLS).

· Communicate effectively

· Read, write, and interpret instructions in the English language

· Previous experience preferred in emergency care

· Must possess a valid Texas driver's license and be insurable.

Allegiance is an EEO employer as defined by the EEOC.

For more than three decades, FoodChain ID has been at the forefront of the New Food industry, helping companies navigate increasing global demands for transparency, accountability, safety, and sustainability.

title: Senior Visual Engineer
description:
Job ID# 1803
StraCon Services Group, LLC is seeking a Senior Visual Engineer to join our team in engineering state-of-the art training system for the DoD, at the Naval Air Warfare Center Training Systems Division (NAWCTSD) in Orlando, Fl. NAWCTSD is the Navy’s principal center for modeling, simulation and training systems technologies. This position is contingent upon funding. The Senior Visual Engineer will be responsible for, but not limited to the following requirements:

Essential Job Functions:
  • Prepare and Analyze technical documentation and prepare technical design approaches for training system(s).
  • The technical design approach shall provide alternative design approaches that will include tradeoff analyses and identify technical risks.
  • Conducting NAWCTSD System Engineering Technical Reviews (SETR).
  • Apply decision analysis techniques to ensure that the engineering approach is cost effective and satisfies the training objectives.
  • Upon determination of the proper engineering approach, prepare a technical description that includes a block diagram and math models.
  • Determine the degree of fidelity of the simulation necessary to maximize the transfer of training.
  • Conducting functional and physical configuration audits with established test procedures.
  • Monitor the configuration management of the training system.
  • Monitor and assess training system hardware and software development status and provide CSS in resolving related programmatic issues.
  • Evaluate technical proposals and work statements submitted by commercial Contractors or in-house resources.
  • Recommend the best technical approach submitted in response to the specification.
  • Clarify engineering design ambiguities, highlighting areas of design deficiency, and resolving conflicts in the proposed engineering technical approach.
  • Document the configuration, design, and performance characteristics of the proposed training system.
  • Develop quantitative criteria and recommend tradeoffs regarding inputs received from supporting personnel concerning training system change(s).
  • Provide Contractor support to planners for budgeting and planning purposes.
  • Develop engineering specifications detailing: design, performance testing, and provisions for the acceptance of the engineering changes.
  • Integration of new and legacy training systems.
  • Analyze potential requirements for modifications on training systems in the operational phase of the training system life cycle. This involves extensive research and coordination, including direct contact with fleet activities, Government laboratories, and device/system users.
  • Develop engineering Specifications and other documents IAW NAWCTSD Orlando's policies and procedures on Technical Procurement Package Preparation and Processing.
  • Review training system Contractors design approach, criteria, and design reports.
  • Continuously assess training system Contractor performance and recommend appropriate action when Contractor delinquencies of deficiencies occur.
  • Recommend changes to the training systems contract based on revisions to military training characteristics, changes to performance characteristics, or for pre-planned product improvements.
  • Experience with Military or Navy Training platforms, Fixed-wing preferred.
Travel Requirements:
  • International Travel Required
Experience Requirements:
  • At least ten (10) years of practical experience with visual engineering systems associated with modeling and simulation within the training and training systems domains.
  • Broad knowledge of support engineering functions such as reliability, maintainability, EMI, logistics, program funding, statistics, facilities, cost estimating, risk analysis/assessment and human factors.
  • Ability to work and coordinate with a variety of professional personnel associated with the assigned duties.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of a wide range of non-engineering, non-scientific information in the form of federal Acquisition Regulations, Military Standards, Department of the Navy (DON)/DOD/NAVAIR policies, directives and instructions and ability to determine the applicability of these documents to assignments.
  • Ability to conduct necessary business with NAVAIR Orlando TSD’s product user activities and sponsors.
  • Research and Development Experience
  • Experience with Navy aviation platforms and simulators desired.
Education Requirements:
  • B.S. in Electronics, Computer, Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Industrial engineering or equivalent.
Security Requirements:
  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
About StraCon:
StraCon is dedicated to supporting our government clients and warfighters by “Enhancing their Operational Capability”. With a proven track record, and an employee focused philosophy, we have developed a culture that believes in the talent of the individual. StraCon employees are empowered to “Make It Happen”. Since 2008, we have provided Program Management, Training Systems Products, Financial Management, Instructional System Design, Data Management, Courseware Development, Engineering, Logistics, Foreign Military Sales Support, and a variety other technical services for the Department of Defense. StraCon offers competitive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment, short/long-term disability, and 401(k) retirement plans, as well as a paid time off programs for eligible full-time employees. Eligible part-time employees are able to participate in the 401(k) retirement plans and may be eligible for state or contract required paid time off programs.
StraCon is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled Employer

title: Speech Pathologist - FEES Specialist
description:
Now is the time to have the Job You Want! Part Time to Full Time Dysphagia Management Specialist in Physician's Office/Clinic Settings, Surrounding Nursing Homes, and a specialized TeleTherapy Portal to help those patients quarantined during this tough time. are available. Would a combination of on-site diagnostics and tele-therapy fit better with your life at this time? This is an amazing opportunity for the clinician who wishes to grow exponentially in dysphagia skills performing FEES and Speech Pathology Diagnostics, while reaching that work-life balance that you have been searching for!

  • The DMS Out-Patient/Physician's Office/ HHC specialized program has been developed over the past 8 years and has a proven record of success in all settings including tele-therapy performed from the comfort of your own home.
  • You can choose to specialize in Dysphagia Diagnosis utilizing FEES as well as short term therapy, OR specialize in therapy alone and leave the FEES performance to another colleague! We need both!
  • Our unique and innovative Dysphagia Systems Test(DST) evaluates the five systems required for safe swallowing: Muscular, Neurological, Respiratory, Gastrointestinal, and Cognitive.
  • Utilizing the DST and incorporating the patient's entire Care Team, you will present a customized diagnostic profile, as well as recommendations for diet, therapy and further evaluations.
  • DMS provides access to online CE content, a weekend scoping course, an observational period, and a comprehensive patient-focused in-the-field learning experience to help you become skilled in FEES to the ASHA standards.
  • A pre/post educational Self-Assessment of Skills is performed to document ASHA-required knowledge and skills.
  • We provide all equipment necessary to perform endoscopic swallowing studies, and offer a mentor program, weekly team calls, and continuing education to support you throughout your career!
  • A commitment to stay with DMS throughout your mentorship results in zero tuition for training!

In this position, you will enjoy a pay system that rewards you for building successful relationships with your customers and providing clinically excellent diagnostics. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurance, and so much more for a full time position.

For more information about this position, please view the following short video FAQ:

Please visit to learn more about us!

Job Requirements

Master's degree in Speech Language Pathology
Completion of Certificate of Clinical Competency

description:
Corporate Land Program Manager

A world where tech and people work collectively to make corporate travel simpler, faster and easier.

Corporate Traveler is one of Flight Centre Travel Group’s (FCTG) most successful brands, globally. Our mission is to dominate the SME market, making the end-to-end travel experience faster, simpler and easier for our customers and to demonstrate ongoing value to decision-makers, travelers and bookers. Award winning, forward thinking and fun to work for – this is a business for people who love travel, are team players and customer service oriented.

To learn more about Corporate Traveler please click HERE

About The Opportunity

Reporting into the Americas Corporate Land Supply team, the Corporate Land Program Manager, Americas will lead hotel and car rate negotiation strategy for SME businesses across Corporate Traveler and Stage & Screen in the US and Canada. This is a highly visible role where you'll combine market intelligence, supplier partnerships, and performance data to shape programs that deliver value for customers while maximizing commercial outcomes for the business.
You'll be the subject matter expert on rate negotiation strategy, building scalable frameworks, influencing internal stakeholders, and creating seamless processes that connect negotiation, rate loading, and commission collection. If you're analytical, commercially minded, and passionate about corporate travel supply strategy, this is an exciting opportunity to make a measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the SME hotel and car rate negotiation expert, advising when to negotiate client-specific rates versus leveraging existing preferred programs
  • Analyze industry benchmarking and internal performance data to develop effective hotel and car program strategies
  • Build and maintain negotiation frameworks that balance customer value with commercial return
  • Translate broader supply strategy and preferred partner priorities into actionable recommendations for SME customers

  • Train sales, account management, and travel consultant teams on negotiation strategy and program positioning

  • Clearly communicate negotiation recommendations and rationale to internal stakeholders

End-to-End Process Ownership

  • Design and implement processes connecting rate negotiation, rate loading, and commission collection
  • Partner with rate loading and commissions teams to ensure negotiated terms are accurately captured and implemented
  • Identify process or data gaps that create revenue leakage or missed commission opportunities
  • Improve program governance, tracking, and compliance across the negotiation lifecycle

Innovation & Efficiency

  • Leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and enhance negotiation strategies
  • Incorporate new data sources into commercial decision-making
  • Utilize AI-driven market trend analysis and predictive insights to inform future program strategy

Reporting & Impact

  • Measure and communicate customer savings, margin improvement, and commission capture

  • Present recommendations, strategies, and results to senior stakeholders in a concise and actionable manner
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience and/or knowledge of corporate transient travel
  • Experience using CVENT Lanyon for transient hotel sourcing and negotiations
  • Experience negotiating hotel and/or car commercial programs strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to build and maintain hotel-level supplier relationships
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to quantify commercial impact and develop data-driven strategies
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple concurrent negotiations and stakeholders
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts
  • Understanding of hotel and car rate structures and corporate travel programs
  • Familiarity with GDS and online booking tools such as Concur and Sabre preferred
  • Experience building and managing cross-functional processes
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • A career, not a job: We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back: Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.


Location – Chicago, Illinois

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

title: Analista de Governança de TI (ITSM/SAM)
description:
Buscamos um(a) Analista de Governança de TI com amplo conhecimento em ITIL e Software Asset Management para atuar em um projeto de implementação e evolução de práticas de gestão de serviços e ativos de software. Essa pessoa terá papel central no entendimento da estrutura de negócio, dos produtos, serviços, processos e ferramentas utilizados pela área. Conhecer as áreas, os produtos, os serviços e os times envolvidos no projeto.
Planejar e conduzir entrevistas, workshops e sessões de levantamento com stakeholders.
Mapear o catálogo de serviços e produtos em nível de Business Area e de produto.
Identificar responsáveis, consumidores, fornecedores, dependências, entradas, saídas e níveis de criticidade.
Levantar e documentar os processos atuais (as is) para proposição de processos futuros (to be)
Mapear fluxos de trabalho, papéis, responsabilidades, aprovações, controles, exceções e pontos de decisão.
Avaliar a aderência dos processos às práticas do ITIL.
Apoiar a implementação de práticas de IT Service Management, Software Asset Management.
Avaliar o uso das ferramentas relacionadas à gestão de serviços e ativos.
Identificar lacunas, duplicidades, atividades manuais, riscos operacionais e oportunidades de simplificação.
Apoiar a definição de políticas, procedimentos, papéis, responsabilidades e mecanismos de governança.
Propor automações e oportunidades de aplicação de IA em processos, documentação, atendimento e governança.
Produzir materiais executivos e documentação operacional estruturada.

Mapa de stakeholders, áreas, times e responsáveis.
Catálogo estruturado de serviços e produtos.
Inventário dos processos existentes e respectivos responsáveis.
Mapas de processos.
Fluxos de trabalho documentados de forma clara e padronizada.
Matriz de papéis e responsabilidades, incluindo RACI.
Mapa de ferramentas, integrações, dados e pontos de controle.
Avaliação de maturidade e aderência às práticas do ITIL.
Identificação de lacunas, riscos, dependências e oportunidades de melhoria.
Modelo operacional para práticas de ITSM e SAM.
Backlog priorizado de melhorias, automações e oportunidades de uso de IA.
Indicadores e recomendações para acompanhamento da evolução.
Documentação consistente, rastreável e compreensível para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

Experiência mínima de 5 anos com governança de TI, gestão de serviços, processos ou áreas relacionadas.

Experiência com implantação ou evolução de gerenciamento de ativos de software.

Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX) Astra ADC provides the foundational services that every Amazon builder depends on to develop, deploy, and operate software from continuous deployment orchestration to testing infrastructure and configuration management. Our team owns and operates critical ASBX services across Amazon's most secure and isolated environments, including CloudFormation, Cloudshell, Managed Developer Environments, Operator Tools etc. We ensure these services maintain parity, reliability, and security across all partitions.

A successful Engineer joining the team will do much more than write code and triage problems. They will operate services at scale in air-gapped environments where standard commercial tooling doesn't exist, drive cross-partition deployment parity, and build the automation that keeps Amazon's most sensitive workloads shipping safely. They will dive deep into complex distributed systems issues and work diligently to improve the builder experience.

The ideal candidate will:

- Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history." The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.
- Have strong Linux & Networking Fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with Linux, preferably in large-scale, distributed environments. You understand networking technology, how services communicate across isolated boundaries, and regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting and technical post-mortem discussions to identify root causes of complex issues.
- Love to code. Whether it's building deployment automation, creating AI-powered operational tooling, or solving complex cross-partition orchestration problems, the ideal candidate will love using technology to solve problems. You have a solid understanding of software development methodology and CI/CD practices.
- Think Big. The ideal candidate will build and deploy solutions that enable thousands of Amazon builders to ship software reliably across multiple isolated regions. You will strive to improve and streamline processes to allow delivery at massive scale.
This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.


A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing deployment health across isolated regions, checking alarms and on-call handoffs. Mid-morning, you're deep in a code review for a cross-partition automation fix, then jump into a design discussion on how to bring a new ASBX service capability to air-gapped environments. After lunch, you troubleshoot a deployment pipeline issue, tracing it from orchestration logs to a configuration mismatch, and ship the fix before end of day. Between the technical depth and the autonomy to own problems end-to-end, no two days look the same.

Mentorship and Career Growth

Diverse Experiences

title: Mid DevOps Engineer (Security and Reliability)
description:
Mid DevOps Engineer (Security and Reliability)

Important: if an employer asks you to log into their system via iCloud or Google, send a code, an SMS or Telegram password, run some code, or install software — refuse. These are signs of fraud.

Mid DevOps Engineer (Security and Reliability)

About us

PLC builds digital health software used by clinicians, physiotherapists and employers in over 100 countries. Our two product lines, (exercise prescription, telehealth and patient engagement) and Champion Health (workplace wellbeing), run on a multi-region AWS platform serving Europe, the UK, North America, Australia and the Middle East.

We are ISO 27001:2022 certified. We hold clinical data and a large proprietary content library, and both need defending properly.

The role

You will own the security and reliability surface of our infrastructure: the edge, the data layer, and the observability stack that tells us when either is misbehaving. It sits where security engineering meets SRE. You will design controls at the edge, harden our cloud posture, make sure we can see what is happening across a multi-region estate, then evidence all of it to auditors and enterprise customers. This is hands-on engineering, not a governance role.

We are recruiting two senior infrastructure roles. This one covers the edge, observability and cloud security posture. The other, Senior DevOps Engineer (Platform), covers the Kubernetes estate, delivery pipelines and migrations. Apply for whichever fits, and tell us if both do.

What you will do

Edge and network security

Own our Envoy based edge, along with WAF rules, rate limiting and bot management across our cloud and CDN layers

Design and tune protections against abuse, including content scraping, credential attacks and traffic anomalies

Build detection for the traffic patterns that matter, and keep improving its signal to noise ratio

Cloud security posture

Harden our AWS estate: IAM boundaries, least privilege access, threat detection and runtime monitoring on EKS

Manage secrets, certificates and token lifecycle across the platform

Produce the infrastructure evidence behind ISO 27001 audits, penetration tests and enterprise security reviews

Run PostgreSQL and RDS in production across regions, covering upgrades, performance, encryption and access control

Own our search infrastructure, Typesense and vector search, end to end

Work with MongoDB and Elasticache alongside the primary data stores

Observability

Own the monitoring platform: Grafana, Loki and Prometheus, plus Sentry and PagerDuty

Build alerting people actually trust, with meaningful thresholds, low noise and clear runbooks

Improve how logs and metrics flow from the edge and the application into the stack

What we are looking for

5+ years in infrastructure, SRE or security engineering, with strong AWS depth

Real experience with edge, WAF or reverse proxy technology: Envoy, nginx, Cloudflare, ModSecurity, Coraza or equivalent

Production Kubernetes, ideally EKS, and strong Terraform

Operating PostgreSQL at scale. You have done upgrades and performance work, not just connected to one

Practical observability experience. You have built alerting that worked, and killed alerting that did not

A security engineer's instincts. You think about what an attacker does with the thing you just shipped

English at a working professional level. Our engineering team is international

Nice to have

Search infrastructure: Typesense, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or vector search

Content protection and anti-scraping work

Having supported ISO 27001, SOC 2 or similar audits from the technical side

Healthcare, fintech or another regulated domain

Polish. Much of the engineering team is in Poland, though the company works in English

How we work

On-call. We run a 24/7 rotation through PagerDuty, with documented playbooks and readiness checklists. Participation is agreed with you rather than assumed, and separately compensated.

Cadence. Written async updates, a fortnightly planning touchpoint and a regular infrastructure and security sync. You set your own hours and choose your own tools.

Documentation. Threat models, decision records and runbooks are part of the work. We expect the reasoning to be written down, not just the config.

Autonomy. Small team, wide scope, very little process between you and a decision.

In line with the market for similar positions

title: Emergency Medical Technician (EMT Basic) for LSA
description:
Lone Star Ambulance and Allegiance Mobile Health of McAllen, TX is looking to hire Emergency Medical Technicians (EMT-B).

SUMMARY: Allegiance Mobile Health is looking for a compassionate and reliable EMT-Basic to provide essential pre-hospital care and emergency medical assistance. The EMT-B will respond to 911 calls, assess patient conditions, perform basic life support procedures, and assist in patient transport and transfer. This role requires strong communication, a calm demeanor under pressure, and a commitment to patient care.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (Responsibilities include, but not limited to)

  • Responds to emergency and non-emergency calls 24 hours per day, drives a variety of emergency vehicles in all road conditions including inclement weather, dense traffic and rural off-road settings.
  • Reads map books and follows written and verbal directions in order to respond in an efficient and safe manner.
  • Follows all departmental, local and state driving laws, policies and procedures.
  • Uses a variety of communication equipment and appropriately communicates verbally to dispatchers, EMS crews, first responders and other organizations according to departmental policies and procedures.
  • Maintains vehicles and equipment in a constant state of readiness and cleanliness.
  • Completes daily vehicle and supply checklists and assists with vehicle re-supply, vehicle and equipment decontamination and general readiness-related tasks.
  • Immediately reports, in writing, any discrepancies with vehicles, supplies or equipment and their state of readiness.
  • Provides direct patient care per Medical Director's authorization and protocols.
  • Demonstrates clinical competency in all patient care related instances.
  • Demonstrates physical competencies sufficient to allow him/her to lift, carry, transport and extricate patients in all settings, in some cases without assistance.
  • Interacts with multiple outside agencies such as Police Departments, Fire Departments and First Responder Organizations. Provides satisfactory customer service and projects professionalism in all contacts.
  • Successfully and accurately completes patient care reports, billing information and all other associated documentation in a timely manner.
  • Works under physically and psychologically taxing conditions to include inclement weather, temperature extremes, hazardous environments, loud noises and high-stress situations. High potential for exposure to blood-borne pathogens, dangerous chemicals, sharp objects and fall/trip hazards.
  • Performs other duties as assigned to include general housekeeping chores and special projects.
  • Must successfully pass departmental skills evaluation and fully complete NEOP process before staffing a truck.
  • Adhere to company policies and procedures.
  • Other duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Lift, carry, balance and push up to 125 pounds (250 pounds with assistance).
  • Demonstrate flexibility and physical coordination by bending from the waist and touching toes, squat with legs parallel to the ground and kneeling with both knees firmly on the ground.
  • Climb 20 sets of stairs without rest within 60 seconds.
  • Demonstrate fine manual dexterity by performing job related clinical skills (starting IV's, intubating, etc.).
  • Have correctable vision adequate to read street signs, see in low light and read small print.

PSYCHOLOGICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Use good judgment and remain calm in high-stress situations.
  • Maintain a positive attitude in the face of adversity.
  • Have good interpersonal and conflict resolution skills.
  • Function under situations of extreme fatigue due to little or no rest, extreme temperatures and inclement weather conditions.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

•     High school graduate or GED.
•     Certified as an EMT in the State of Texas
•     CPR certification
•     911 Areas – Pre-Hospital Trauma Life Support (PHTLS) or International Trauma Life Support (ITLS).
•     Communicate effectively
•     Read, write, and interpret instructions in the English language
•     Previous experience preferred in emergency care
•     Must possess a valid Texas driver's license and an insurable driver record.

description:
**Summary**

Historic England is the public organisation that brings new life to heritage to build a better future for every place and everyone.

Historic England has a fantastic opportunity for you to join us as our Part Time Research Coordinator.

**This is part time, permanent role.**

The location of this role is either York, Manchester, Newcastle, Birmingham, Cambridge, Swindon, Bristol, Portsmouth or London, inclusive with hybrid working.

We offer a wide benefits package including a competitive defined benefit **pension scheme to which we make 28.97% employer contributions,** a generous 28 days holiday, corporate discounts, free entry into English Heritage sites across the country and development opportunities to ensure you achieve your goals.

To view our full range of benefits please follow the link [here](https://historicengland.org.uk/about/jobs/employee-rewards-and-benefits/).

**What you will be doing**

The primary purpose of this post is to support the Research Development Team in their work to grow Historic England’s reputation as an Independent Research Organisation (IRO) through successful partnerships with Higher Education Institutions (HEIs), IROs and other research bodies.  You will assist the team to develop research strategy, build relationships, submit high quality research funding proposals, monitor successful applications through post-award stages, including research dissemination, and run our Arts and Humanities Research Council–funded Collaborative Doctoral Partnership (CDP) and other doctoral programmes.  You will also provide occasional and pre-defined direct project support for the delivery of externally funded research.

Working closely with the Head of Research Development, Research Partnerships Manager (pre-award) and Research Manager (post-award), you will engage with staff across Historic England and externally to help build research opportunities and income in line with our corporate plan and research strategies.

**Who we are looking for**

- A high-quality qualification in a relevant subject or equivalent relevant experience

- Experience of supporting partnerships between organisations, ideally within in a research context

- An understanding of the Higher Education sector and research

- Demonstrable commitment to supporting early career skills development

- Experience in project and/or information co-ordination

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Excellent organisational skills


**Please note your application will be scored and assessed against the above criteria.**

We also want to provide you with the best balance in your home and work life that we can.

**Why work for Historic England**

We are committed to promoting equality of opportunity for everyone. Diversity helps us to perform better and attract more people to support our work. We welcome and encourage job applications from people of all backgrounds.

title: Senior ML Solutions Architect - Token Factory
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior ML Solutions Architect - Token Factory based in Ireland.

Join a fast-growing AI infrastructure team building a serverless platform for running and customizing open-source LLMs in production.
Help customers move from AI prototypes to scalable, reliable production applications without building their own complex inference stacks.
Design optimized inference workflows and customized LLM solutions across multiple models and modalities.
Work hands-on with inference, fine-tuning, evaluation, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation.
Partner directly with customers to understand technical challenges and translate them into effective AI architectures.
Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to turn customer feedback into platform improvements.
Work remotely across Europe in an international environment focused on high-impact AI projects, technical ownership, and continuous innovation.

Accountabilities

  • Optimize LLM inference workflows across different modalities to deliver measurable business value and meet customer requirements.
  • Support customers with supervised and reinforcement-learning-based fine-tuning approaches to improve model quality and performance.
  • Design and implement LLM-powered solutions using serverless inference services and served open-source models.
  • Build production-ready applications using LLM APIs, including multimodal models covering text, vision, audio, and domain-specific use cases.
  • Provide technical guidance on prompt engineering, RAG architectures, model selection, inference optimization, and deployment strategies.
  • Guide customers through the transition from proof of concept to production, with a focus on performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to communicate customer needs, identify platform gaps, and contribute to roadmap development.
  • Help customers select appropriate models, inference configurations, and fine-tuning strategies based on their use cases and technical constraints.
  • Contribute to improving the platform and its capabilities by sharing practical insights from customer implementations and production workloads.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional experience working with ML/AI systems, including at least 2 years focused specifically on LLMs and generative AI.
    • Deep understanding of the modern LLM ecosystem, including model architectures, inference approaches, and fine-tuning techniques.
    • Hands-on experience running LLMs in production, including deploying and operating inference workloads at scale.
    • Strong practical experience with LLM fine-tuning, including supervised fine-tuning, SFT, LoRA, and data preparation or curation; experience with reinforcement-learning-based fine-tuning is a strong advantage.
    • Experience building LLM evaluation frameworks, including task-specific benchmarks, offline and online evaluation pipelines, and LLM-as-a-judge approaches.
    • Practical experience with modern inference frameworks and ML libraries such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or Transformers.
