title: Project Coordinator Scaling Sayana Press
description:
This role was posted on September 17, 2026. Please note that we will review applications on a rolling basis.

About Last Mile Health

Last Mile Health saves lives in the world's most remote communities. Our vision is a health worker within reach of everyone, everywhere. We partner with governments to recruit, train, equip, and integrate professional community health workers into national health systems, equipping them to deliver quality primary care in rural and remote communities. Founded in Liberia in 2007, we now operate programs in Ethiopia, Liberia, Sierra Leone, and Malawi. Our global offices are located in Accra, Ghana, and in the United States. We are looking for mission-driven leaders to join us as we work to ensure no patient is out of reach.

About the Liberia Team

Partnering with the Ministry of Health since 2007, the Liberia team pioneered the community health worker model that serves as a national blueprint. Originating in the remote Konobo District, their work demonstrated that professional community health workers could drastically increase health-seeking behavior and improve health outcomes, increasing skilled birth attendance from 55% to 84%. Led by Brittney Varpilah, the team champions a supervised, salaried, supplied, and skilled workforce to deliver primary care in the country’s hardest-to-reach regions. Beyond delivery, they strengthen health systems through high-level advocacy and policy design while upskilling the workforce through rigorous training and continuous quality improvement.

The Role

At Last Mile Health, we are all stewards of our reputation and resources. Do you have extensive experience and a proven track record of coordinating project rollouts, providing technical support for community-based family planning services, and collaborating with county and district health teams? If so, then you may be our next Project Coordinator, Scaling Sayana Press.

Working in partnership with the Ministry of Health (MOH), County Health Teams (CHTs), and District Health Teams, the Project Coordinator will help translate the approved project design, national family planning guidance, commodity tracking and processes, and service delivery protocols into consistent delivery across eight counties (Bong, Grand Bassa, Lofa, Margibi, Nimba, Rivercess, Montserrado and Bomi). The Project Coordinator will promote equitable access, service delivery quality, reliable commodity availability, accurate data, continuous learning, and government ownership. The position will improve family planning availability for approximately 42,000 women and adolescent girls in rural and hard-to-reach communities covering 70% of the national population living more than 5km from the nearest health facility

About Scaling Suyana Press Project

Sayana Press is an all-in-one presentation of subcutaneous depot medroxyprogesterone acetate (DMPA-SC), an injectable contraceptive administered every three months. Liberia has used community-based provision of Sayana Press to bring voluntary family planning closer to women and adolescent girls who face long travel times and limited access to health facilities. The LMH-supported scale-up will strengthen and use existing MOH training, supervision, and supply chain systems to improve timely access to Sayana Press for more than 42,000 women and girls in rural and remote communities.

This position is fixed-term, on-site, and based in Monrovia, Liberia, and is only open to candidates who are Liberian nationals currently located in Liberia.

Duration: 24 Months

What You’ll Do

Field Implementation, demand generation, supply chain, and continuous technical support

  • Coordinate the development of information, education, and communication materials in local dialects to increase awareness of the availability of community-level family planning services, including Sayana Press.
  • Provide continuous technical support to trained personnel at national, county, district, and community levels to ensure consistent and high-quality implementation of Sayana Press Service Delivery.
  • Support or coordinate the procurement of 150,000 doses of Sayana Press to augment MOH’s planned allocation for the National Community Health Program and distribute approximately 230,000 doses to reach 42,000+ women, providing 18 months of contraceptive coverage (six injections per user, administered quarterly).
  • Implement and monitor quality assurance mechanisms across service delivery activities, including adherence to clinical protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs), correct use of reporting tools, and data accuracy standards.
  • Facilitate feedback collection and integrate lessons learned into the family planning service delivery for continuous improvement.

Refresher Training, Supervision, and Monitoring and Evaluation

  • Coordinate and support refresher training for CHAs to reinforce competencies in Sayana Press service delivery, referral, and reporting.
  • Plan, coordinate, and support quarterly integrated supervision visits to the project implementation counties to assess the quality of Sayana Press service delivery, referral practices, access supply chain gaps, and address challenges.
  • Oversee data entry and management using standardized tracking tools to ensure timely, accurate, and complete data capture to ensure accurate consumption and forecasting of Sayana Press for future procurement.
  • Support implementation-learning, costing, evaluation, and knowledge management activities to inform continuous improvement, sustainability, cost reduction, and future national scale-up.

Advocacy and stakeholders’ coordination

  • Plan and coordinate advocacy activities at the Ministry of Health, Subnational (County Health Teams), district, and community levels to raise awareness and generate demand for Sayana Press services.
  • Build and maintain strong working partnerships with the Ministry of Health (MoH), County and District Health Teams, implementing partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Actively participate in technical working groups (TWGs) and coordination forums to share updates, align strategies, promote learning, and advocate increased investments for Sayana Press Procurement.

Participate in additional Programs or cross-team activities, as requested

  • Actively participate in the LMH Liberia program’s internal team technical working group meetings​​​​​.
  • Support other emerging Programs team needs as determined by the manager.

What you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree with experience in the field of public health, Nursing, Community Health, Health Services Management.
  • Relevant years of professional experience in one or more of the work areas highlighted in the job summary.
  • Demonstrated experience working within the national and/or sub-national health system (community health workers program a plus); familiarity with government structures and processes.
  • Demonstrated experience working in primary health care intervention.
  • Familiarity with the Community Health Information System and DHIS2.
  • Ability to diplomatically navigate complex stakeholder dynamics, proactively problem-solve, and achieve results and consensus with multiple influencers.
  • Demonstrated experience in partner engagement and project management.
  • Comfortable working in teams as well as acting independently in the implementation of specific tasks, prioritizing, working under pressure, and meeting deadlines.
  • Robust knowledge management skills, including the advanced use of MS Office applications and Google Suite.

You’ll impress us if you have

  • Digital health program design or implementation experience
  • Facilitation of training/capacity strengthening for adult learners
  • Knowledge of the application of AI for health service delivery
  • Knowledge of existing data being tracked in DHIS2, specifically community health data.
  • Experience implementing an advocacy agenda with national and subnational government stakeholders

We're looking for someone with many of the qualifications listed above, but we know no one meets every requirement. If you're excited about our mission and believe your experience aligns with this role, we encourage you to apply.

Compensation information

At Last Mile Health, we are committed to equitable and transparent compensation. Employees are paid using a clear, consistent methodology that is fully transparent and accessible to everyone. We look forward to answering any questions you may have during the hiring process. Before applying to this role, please take a moment to learn more about our approach to compensation and how compensation works in each of the countries where we operate. Please find the link to our compensation model and benefits overview below:

OVERVIEW OF LAST MILE HEALTH’S COMPENSATION MODEL

Compensation for this position:

The Band for this position: LBR-2

For Liberia, the range is an annual gross of $13,404 to $22,340 USD, dependent upon experience doing an equivalent role. Please note that compensation is subject to statutory taxes.

Benefits:

  • Healthcare: Comprehensive health insurance and wellbeing support for you and your dependents.
  • Save for retirement: Retirement options with a 3% employer match, varying by location.
  • Paid time off: Generous paid time off, sick leave, quarterly company holidays, and approximately one week of office closure at the end of the year.

title: Systems Development Engineer, Frontier Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC)
description:
The Frontier ADC team is at the forefront of delivering the AWS GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio to our customers in GovCloud and isolated environments. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what is possible in this rapidly evolving field, leveraging the power of cloud computing and the latest advancements in artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies. With a focus on expanding Frontier AI services across GovCloud and isolated regions, driving automation investments, and delivering innovative solutions, we are at the forefront of modernization. Our teams are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed systems and delivering the next generation of cloud computing across the GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio. We support the GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio including services like Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Kiro.

We are seeking a Systems Development Engineer I who can think big and simplify solutions to complex problems, all while ensuring our customers continue to have the best experience possible!

A successful Systems Development Engineer I joining the team will be an innovator, building solutions and working closely with Amazon's largest and most demanding government customers to address their specific needs across a suite of Frontier AI services in GovCloud and isolated environments. They will drive the resolution of technical issues and work diligently to improve the customer experience.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will:

• Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history". The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.

• Have strong Linux & Networking Fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with Linux, preferably in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting and conduct technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

• Have strong software and systems skills. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with systems in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You are comfortable facilitating deep-dive troubleshooting and leading technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

• Love to solve problems. The ideal candidate will love leading teams to solve difficult technical problems related to AWS service builds and operations in GovCloud and isolated environments. You have a solid understanding of systems design, operations, automation, and process improvement.

• Think Big. The ideal candidate will work on projects building and deploying solutions across GovCloud and isolated regions. You will strive to build a culture to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

A day in the life
As a Systems Development Engineer I in Frontier ADC, you will build innovative solutions, expand services into GovCloud and isolated regions, and improve our operations to provide resiliency and the best experience for our customers. You influence technical strategy and architectural decisions within the team and with partner teams and make data-driven decisions. Successful candidates will be expected to show leadership on strong Bias for Action, Invent and Simplify, Insist on the Highest Standards, and Deliver Results.

You will develop, build, and operate AWS Frontier AI services that enable customers to leverage generative AI and agentic capabilities in secure environments. Our engineering teams support services running in GovCloud and isolated regions, creating unique engineering challenges and opportunities for innovation. The Frontier ADC team is responsible for diving deep to resolve operational challenges, innovating to automate operational tasks, building solutions for our customers, supporting execution of various security campaigns (blocked software, host patching), and parity programs.

As a Systems Development Engineer I you will:

• Work cross-functionally to foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues.

• Love to code. Whether it's building tools in Java or solving complex system problems in Python, the ideal candidate will love using technology to solve problems.

• Think Big. The ideal candidate will build and deploy solutions across thousands of devices. You will strive to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

title: Senior Product Designer (Growth)

Own product design work across the Growth stream, from early problem framing through build-ready delivery and post-launch iteration.
Turn complex customer journeys into clear, intuitive, and implementation-ready experiences with minimal rework.

Use research, behavioural data, experimentation, and customer evidence to inform design decisions rather than relying on assumptions.
Contribute to a growing Design System while exploring practical ways to use AI to improve design workflows.

  • Incorporate AI into the design workflow to accelerate exploration and delivery while keeping processes repeatable, transparent, and understandable to the wider team.
  • Participate actively in research and evidence-gathering activities, including concept, usability, and comprehension testing.
  • Translate research findings, product data, behavioural insights, and experiment results into practical design decisions.
  • Design customer journeys within a regulated environment, prioritizing clarity, genuine customer understanding, and fair treatment.
  • Balance design quality, customer needs, technical feasibility, and delivery speed using sound product judgement.

title: Systems Lead - Programme
description:
Company: Ultra Intelligence & Communications

Cyber (UK) Business

## **Powering Decision**

Join the team redefining defense technology. From engineering systems that save lives to leading programs that change the battlefield—find your place in the future of defense.

**Cyber Business**

Our Cyber business unit is at the forefront of pioneering advanced cryptographic and key management solutions, facilitating the confidential exchange of vital information for customers operating at both tactical and strategic echelons. Join our team and participate in the innovation that ensures the highest security and trust worldwide.

## **Job Description**

The Ultra Engineering function manages a portfolio of specialist capabilities, generating highly differentiated solutions and products by applying, systematically, electronic, mechanical, and software technologies in demanding and critical environments to meet customer needs. Within the Engineering function the Systems Engineering discipline ensures a defined multi/inter-discipline approach and assures the cross-discipline solution/products support a compliant system, offering a means to gain stakeholder acceptance.

The Systems Lead – Programme role is responsible for, and assures, a hierarchical implementation of the ISO 15288 processes and practices across the Systems Engineering life cycle, for the assigned programme/multiple projects. This Lead role owns the solution in response to the collective technical requirements for a programme/set of projects; furthering the clarity of the requirements for engagement and flow down to the other disciplines; quantifying the relationships of the projects in the programme; managing the delivery of the required deliverables associated to the candidate solution/capability, whilst also assuring the evidence-base offers a managed approach to progressive acceptance.

As a professional at this grade, they need to be able to apply their technical and leadership knowledge, making independent judgements based on reasoned decision making and significant previous experience. Often seen as a referral point or more senior team member, to escalate more complex challenges and opportunities to both the programme and Systems discipline. This role is expected to act independently with minimal guidance and may mentor programme/project managers/other discipline leads/engineers/early careers.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Represents the Systems discipline as the lead Systems Engineer assigned to a programme/projects, owning the totality of the Systems assigned work packages and tasking, to deliver obligations and commitments to the agreed processes, plans, quality, schedule and budget.
- Supports the Engineering Programme Lead (EPL) in delivering the delegated engineering management obligations of a programme, to the agreed plans, budget and schedule. Defines the team resources needed and delegates leadership and technical responsibilities applicable to the assigned work packages and assurance tasks to the allocated systems project teams.
- Is responsible for all aspects of the development of technical capabilities/solutions for large and complex engineering problems, demonstrate alignment to Systems Engineering practices, principles and processes, to ensure customer requirements are satisfied.
- Supports and assures each project allocated Principal System Lead in the development of technical capabilities/solutions assuring the application of applicable practices, principles and processes, to ensure customer requirements are satisfied on each project in the programme/assigned project.
- Quantifies and implements a marriage of technical processes and technical management processes to achieve the desired capability/solution, delivering Systems Engineering artefacts, as required, across the engineering development lifecycle, to result in a positive outcome.
- Provide technical direction and exert technical influence across the programme, such that the optimal approach, applicable processes, risk mitigations, architecture, design, and implementation are selected/identified.
- Work closely with the system, hardware, firmware and software architects and design authorities to ensure consistency, design for modularity and re-use, and technical excellence.
- Plan and deliver design reviews, to senior management and customers, to a level of clarity and quality to ensure a successful event/outcome.
- Leads, manages and reports Systems aspects of the programme to achieve optimal balance between requirements, solution maturity, technical risk, schedule and cost.
- Manage customers and external suppliers to define and achieve expectations and objectives, for the System lead to achieve acceptance via the technical capability and related products.
- Ensure and review technical/task proposals, providing accurate estimates for the associated effort, costs and risks, for bids and proposals, leading to contract award.
- Technically lead other programme/project discipline lead/s, working with programme management and the engineering programme lead, to create proposals associated to the technical solution, that drive down project costs, risk and increase margin.
- Reviews and signs off significant technical documents; frequently supporting the technical review chair with the significant deliverables.

title: Cloud/DevOps Engineer @ Link Group
description:
We are seeking an experienced Cloud & DevOps Engineer to join a global technical initiative focused on migrating and hosting mission-critical Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) on modern Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will lead the infrastructure deployment, container orchestration, and continuous delivery pipelines for a core enterprise Java application provided by a major third-party software vendor. Your primary impact will be driving platform automation, system reliability, and observability rather than writing business application code.


  • Professional Background: Min. 4–5+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, and DevOps methodologies.

  • IaC & Automation: Proven proficiency in Terraform (or Pulumi) for Infrastructure-as-Code, along with Configuration Management tools (Chef or Ansible).
  • Continuous Delivery: Demonstrated experience with GitOps and modern CI/CD tooling, particularly Jenkins and ArgoCD.
  • OS & Scripting: Strong expertise in Linux-based environments and scripting languages (Bash, Python, or Go).
  • Observability: Practical experience setting up metrics, logging, and dashboards via Prometheus & Grafana.

Desirable / Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in regulated industries (Pharmaceutical, MedTech, or Biotech) or working with enterprise manufacturing execution systems (MES).
  • Exposure to distributed messaging systems (RabbitMQ) or specialized enterprise print services (CUPS).

We are seeking an experienced Cloud & DevOps Engineer to join a global technical initiative focused on migrating and hosting mission-critical Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) on modern Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will lead the infrastructure deployment, container orchestration, and continuous delivery pipelines for a core enterprise Java application provided by a major third-party software vendor. Your primary impact will be driving platform automation, system reliability, and observability rather than writing business application code.

,(Cloud Infrastructure & IaC: Provision, manage, and scale enterprise Azure cloud environments using Terraform or Pulumi, ensuring full alignment with strict security and compliance baselines., Kubernetes Orchestration: Deploy and manage application workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) utilizing Helm charts for seamless configuration management and release rollouts., CI/CD Automation: Design, optimize, and maintain automated deployment pipelines using tools such as Jenkins and ArgoCD to support continuous delivery across global sites., Observability & Monitoring: Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and telemetry dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana to ensure high availability and operational visibility., System Integration & Tooling: Build and maintain infrastructure automation services (leveraging languages like Go, Python, or Bash), messaging workflows (RabbitMQ), and configuration management tools (Chef / Ansible)., Migration & Escalation Support: Collaborate with cross-functional global teams during system migrations, upgrades, and real-time infrastructure troubleshooting.) title: Health Information Management Specialist
description:
HIMS Specialist
Health Information Management Systems - Grand River Health | Rifle, CO

At Grand River, we are more than a hospital - we are neighbors taking care of neighbors proudly serving residents of Western Colorado and beyond. Our supportive culture is built on respect, friendliness, and a shared commitment to exceptional patient care.

What You’ll Do

The HIM Specialist is responsible for maintaining accurate, complete, and timely medical records in both electronic and paper formats. This role ensures patient documentation is properly compiled, verified, and processed to support quality care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. Responsibilities and expectations may vary based on experience and demonstrated performance, with more experienced specialists handling complex records, assisting with audits, analyzing trends, and providing guidance to other team members.

  • Maintain medical records by reviewing, verifying, and organizing patient information in accordance with hospital policies and procedures.
  • Accurately scan and index documents into the electronic health record (EHR) system.
  • Maintain and update the master patient index (MPI) to ensure correct patient identification.
  • Assign chart deficiencies and resolve discrepancies by collecting and analyzing data from patient records.
  • Input patient demographics, diagnoses, and treatment details with a high level of accuracy.
  • Process requests for protected health information (PHI) from patients, departments, healthcare providers, and legal entities while adhering to privacy regulations.
  • Follow release-of-information policies and legal requirements to protect sensitive health information.
  • Communicate professionally with providers, peers, and third parties regarding medical records and documentation.
  • Collaborate with other departments to collect missing documentation and ensure complete patient records.
  • Prepare statistical reports summarizing diagnoses, treatments, surgeries, and hospital utilization.
  • Adhere to HIPAA regulations and maintain patient privacy at all times.
  • Provide excellent customer service and foster strong working relationships within the HIM department and across the organization.
  • Perform a variety of tasks and other duties as assigned.

Additional responsibilities at advanced levels (II–III) may include:

  • Handle more complex record management tasks, including auditing, discrepancy resolution, and problem-solving.

The role offers meaningful opportunities to improve both operational efficiency and the experience of clinicians and patients.

title: Utilities Specialist 1-3
description:
About this Job

This position plays a key role in supporting the regulation of utility companies and common carriers across Louisiana. Responsibilities include providing technical and analytical support, reviewing applications and tariffs, ensuring regulatory compliance, supporting rate and ownership reviews, investigating consumer complaints, and contributing to hearings when needed.

In this role, you’ll help advance the Commission’s mission to balance fair returns for utilities with safe, reliable, and reasonably priced services for Louisiana customers.

If you’re ready to apply your expertise to impactful regulatory work—from evaluating filings to helping shape decisions that affect utilities statewide—we encourage you to apply today.

Minimum Qualifications

A bachelor's degree in accounting, economics, finance, or statistics.

Job Specification

The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here.

Job Duties and Other Information

Job Duties:

  • Review requests for authority from Telecommunications Service Providers (TSP’s). Evaluates the application and proposed tariff for compliance with all LPSC Orders, Rules, and Regulations. Works closely with the Petitioner to resolve any deficiencies, facilitating the application process to completion, including the issuance of a Certificate of Authority.
  • Assists the Legal Division in the review of applications from regulated providers to ensure proper rate application, flow-through procedures, proposed changes of ownership/control, name changes, and assessment of fees in accordance with federal, state, and local regulations, and ensures the utility submits any appropriate required compliance reports timely once a Commission order has been issued.
  • Maintains monthly bill comparisons for water and sewer utilities for distribution to Commissioners and Staff.
  • Maintains record of notices sent from other regulatory agencies detailing any type of enforcement action issued to a utility and tracks the company responses to these enforcement actions and send out notices of these actions to the Commissioners and their Executive Assistants.
  • May testify at LPSC Hearings before an Administrative Law Judge with regard to any Water or Wastewater Utility docketed proceeding.
  • Maintains a working knowledge and is able to interpret Commission Orders concerning the provision of telecommunications services.
  • Evaluates filings from regulated TSPs that make notification of a proposed change of ownership or control, or a proposed change in corporate name, and ensures requests comply with all relevant LPSC Orders, Rules, and Regulations.
  • Reviews applications for authority from Water and/or Wastewater Providers.
  • Receives and investigates complaints regarding rates and services of telecommunications, water, wastewater, electric, or natural gas utilities regulated by the LPSC.

  • Check relevant inventory to ensure adequate supplies are ordered, prepared and ready for use.

  • Maintain responsibility for ensuring the provision of a safe working environment, adhering to requirements of hospital policies and procedures relating to Work, Health & Safety and Infection Control.

title: Security Engineer II – Hybrid Cloud
description:
Patient First is seeking a Security Engineer II to support operational security responsibilities while strengthening cloud-native security across Azure and Microsoft 365 environments. This role combines current security operations, vulnerability management, monitoring, auditing, firewall/EDR/SIEM support, and compliance reporting with future-state responsibilities for Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, RBAC, Conditional Access, centralized logging, incident response, and cloud governance enforcement.

The responsibilities of this job include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Implementing and maintaining Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, security baseline controls, and cloud posture recommendations;
  • Configuring and supporting RBAC, Conditional Access, privileged access, and identity governance models for Azure and Microsoft 365;
  • Maintaining centralized logging, alerting, and monitoring pipelines for cloud workloads and security investigations;
  • Supporting security gates in deployment workflows, including policy validation, access review, and exception management;
  • Providing security input during architecture reviews, workload intake, and production go-live readiness;
  • Moving security from after-the-fact review into design-time and pipeline-integrated governance;
  • Standardizing cloud security baselines and reducing dependency on manual security validation;
  • Translating existing security policies into Azure Policy, RBAC standards, and operational control requirements;
  • Improving auditability by aligning monitoring, logging, access review, and compliance reporting to cloud workloads;
  • Supporting security operations including firewall management, IDS/IPS/EDR management, security monitoring, auditing, vulnerability management, and patch- related security coordination;
  • Investigating alerts, participating in incident response, and supporting threat hunting, log review, and risk analysis activities;
  • Assisting with security reviews for applications, systems, third-party vendors, and hybrid cloud implementations;
  • Supporting compliance activities related to HIPAA, PCI, access control, vulnerability remediation, and audit evidence;
  • Communicating security risks and remediation recommendations to technical teams and business stakeholders.

Minimum education and professional requirements include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Employee must be 18 years of age or older;
  • High school diploma or equivalent;
  • At least three years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, cloud security, or hybrid infrastructure security roles;
  • Experience with Azure security services, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sentinel or SIEM tools, identity, RBAC, and access control concepts;
  • Understanding of vulnerability management, logging, alerting, incident response, and compliance evidence expectations;
  • Working knowledge of hybrid environments including Windows/Linux systems, networking, firewalls, SaaS/PaaS/IaaS security, and Microsoft 365;
  • Ability to communicate risk, remediation options, and control requirements clearly across technical and non-technical audiences;
  • Experience in regulated, or compliance-driven environments; healthcare experience preferred;
  • Knowledge of NIST, HIPAA, PCI, CIS, COBIT, or similar security frameworks;
  • Azure Security Engineer Associate, CISSP, or comparable security certification;
  • Experience with SIEM/SOAR, DLP, EDR, vulnerability scanning, and cloud security posture management tools.


Salary Range: $125,000 - $150,000 annually, depending on experience.

title: Software Development Engineer, Frontier Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC)
description:
Application deadline: Sep 22, 2026

The Frontier ADC team is at the forefront of delivering the AWS GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio to our customers in GovCloud and isolated environments. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what is possible in this rapidly evolving field, leveraging the power of cloud computing and the latest advancements in artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies. With a focus on expanding Frontier AI services across GovCloud and isolated regions, driving automation investments, and delivering innovative solutions, we are at the forefront of modernization. Our teams are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed systems and delivering the next generation of cloud computing across the GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio. We support the GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio including services like Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Kiro.

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer II who can think big and simplify solutions to complex problems, all while ensuring our customers continue to have the best experience possible!

A successful Software Development Engineer II joining the team will be an innovator, building solutions and working closely with Amazon's largest and most demanding government customers to address their specific needs across a suite of Frontier AI services in GovCloud and isolated environments. They will drive the resolution of technical issues and work diligently to improve the customer experience.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will:

• Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history". The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.

• Have strong Linux & Networking Fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with Linux, preferably in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting and conduct technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

• Have strong software and systems skills. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with systems in a large scale, distributed environment. You understand networking technology and how servers and networks inter-relate. You are comfortable facilitating deep-dive troubleshooting and leading technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

• Love to solve problems. The ideal candidate will love leading teams to solve difficult technical problems related to AWS service builds and operations in GovCloud and isolated environments. You have a solid understanding of systems design, operations, automation, and process improvement.

• Think Big. The ideal candidate will work on projects building and deploying solutions across GovCloud and isolated regions. You will strive to build a culture to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer II in Frontier ADC, you will build innovative solutions, expand services into GovCloud and isolated regions, and improve our operations to provide resiliency and the best experience for our customers. You influence technical strategy and architectural decisions within the team and with partner teams and make data-driven decisions. Successful candidates will be expected to show leadership on strong Bias for Action, Invent and Simplify, Insist on the Highest Standards, and Deliver Results.

You will develop, build, and operate AWS Frontier AI services that enable customers to leverage generative AI and agentic capabilities in secure environments. Our engineering teams support services running in GovCloud and isolated regions, creating unique engineering challenges and opportunities for innovation. The Frontier ADC team is responsible for diving deep to resolve operational challenges, innovating to automate operational tasks, building solutions for our customers, supporting execution of various security campaigns (blocked software, host patching), and parity programs.

As a Software Development Engineer II you will:

• Work cross-functionally to foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues.

• Love to code. Whether it's building tools in Java or solving complex system problems in Python, the ideal candidate will love using technology to solve problems.

• Think Big. The ideal candidate will build and deploy solutions across thousands of devices. You will strive to improve and streamline processes to allow for work on a massive scale.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

title: Embedded Learning Specialist
description: The ideal candidate will join a vibrant and inclusive educational community and have a desire and ability to work with a diverse student population. title: PowerApps/Power Platform Architect
description:
The PowerApps/Power Platform Architect supports the design, development, and implementation of secure, scalable Microsoft Power Platform solutions for federal government customers. This role works closely with program leadership, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to translate mission and business requirements into compliant, user-centric applications. The position is hands-on, balancing solution architecture, technical leadership, and direct development support within regulated federal environments.
  • Design and implement solutions using Power Apps (Canvas and Model-Driven), Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power BI
  • Translate federal business and mission requirements into technical solution designs, data models, and architecture artifacts
  • Support integrations with Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure services, and external systems using APIs and connectors
  • Develop and review technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and design deliverables required for federal programs
  • Provide technical guidance and oversight to developers, ensuring adherence to Power Platform best practices and performance standards
  • Participate in hands-on development, configuration, testing, and troubleshooting of Power Platform solutions
  • Support environment strategy (Dev/Test/Prod), solution packaging, and structured deployment processes
  • Implement role-based security, data access controls, and data loss prevention policies
  • Ensure solutions align with federal security, compliance, and governance requirements (e.g., NIST, FISMA, agency standards)
  • Support Agile delivery activities including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and stakeholder reviews
  • Collaborate with program managers, business analysts, and government stakeholders to prioritize enhancements and manage technical risks

  • 5–7 years of overall IT or application development experience
  • 2–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
  • Experience supporting federal government programs or federal systems integrators
  • Strong experience with Power Apps (Canvas and Model-Driven), Power Automate (cloud flows), Dataverse data modeling and security, and Power BI
  • Experience integrating Power Platform solutions with Microsoft 365, Azure services, and REST APIs
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, SQL, or C# for advanced customization and integrations
  • Understanding of low-code application architecture patterns and enterprise solution design
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery environments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Certifications (Preferred)
  • Microsoft Power Platform certifications such as PL-100, PL-200, or PL-400
  • PL-600 (Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert) preferred but not required
  • Azure or security-focused certifications are a plus
Security Requirements
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Secret clearance, depending on program requirements

title: Coördinator recruitment talentcenter
description:
Ben jij de gedreven Coördinator Recruitment Talent Center die sturing geeft aan ons wervingsproces en energie krijgt van resultaten behalen? Bij Tempo-Team krijg je dé kans om de spil te zijn tussen recruitment, de interne organisatie en onze landelijke topklanten. Met jouw leiderschap, sterke communicatie en flexibele instelling til je onze recruitment operatie naar een hoger niveau. Lees snel verder!

Naast werkplezier, krijg je ook dit van ons

Bij ons krijg je het beste van twee werelden: de power dan tools van een grote marktleider, maar met de vrijheid van een eigen ondernemer. Geen strak keurslijf, maar juist alle ruimte om je eigen koers te varen en je werkweek flexibel in te delen. Samen met een team vol ambitie gaan we voor de beste resultaten. Heb jij het lef om te knallen? Dan zetten wij daar natuurlijk een pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden tegenover waar je écht blij van wordt. Werk met plezier!

  • Lekker loon en fijne extra’s: je start als Coördinator Recruitment Talent Center met een bruto basissalaris tussen de €3.200 - €3.900 per maand, afgestemd op wat jij aan ervaring meebrengt. Bovenop je loon krijg je elke maand een Benefit Budget van 12,347% (dat is zo’n €395,- tot €481,- extra per maand). Jij bent de baas over dit budget: laat het direct uitbetalen voor wat extra cash, spaar het op voor later, of ruil het in voor extra vakantiedagen. Je kunt het zelfs slim inzetten voor je sportabonnement of het aflossen van je studieschuld. Hoe fijn is dat?

  • Onkosten? Fixen we!: Maandelijks ontvang je een onkostenvergoeding à €61,- netto bovenop je bruto salaris;

  • Tijd voor jezelf: Op je verjaardag ben je natuurlijk vrij; dat is ons cadeautje aan jou! Verder heb je naast de standaard 25 vakantiedagen de mogelijkheid om tot vijf weken extra verlof bij te kopen. Heb je grotere plannen? Dan kun je elke drie jaar een sabbatical opnemen om je batterij weer helemaal op te laden;

  • Jouw inzet beloond: Je kunt rekenen op een bonusregeling waarbij je een extraatje ontvangt op basis van de resultaten van de organisatie;

  • Een vliegende start: Vergeet saaie inwerkperiodes! Naast de training on-the-job stomen we je klaar met ons prijswinnende onboardingprogramma: de StartUp. Je leert razendsnel onze merken en strategie kennen, zodat we samen een stevige fundering leggen voor jouw carrière;

  • Reis op jouw manier: Pak een leasefiets of stap relaxed de trein in met een NS Business Card (die je ook privé mag gebruiken!). Ga je liever met je eigen auto of motor? Dan krijg je van ons een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer;

  • Bouwen aan je toekomst: Bij Tempo-Team investeer je in jezelf. Ontdek je groeikansen via onze trainingen en krijg direct inzicht in je positie met de Arbeidsmarktwaarde Scan. Inclusief coaching, zodat jij altijd de controle houdt over je volgende stap.

Dit zit in jouw DNA

Als Coördinator Recruitment Talent Center sta jij stevig in je schoenen, ben je van nature een initiatiefnemer en hou je makkelijk het overzicht. Je bent resultaatgericht, beschikt over een flinke dosis overtuigingskracht en schroomt niet om beslissingen te nemen. Je denkt in oplossingen, kunt snel schakelen onder druk en beschikt over een duidelijke ambitie om door te groeien.

  • Je bent 40 uur per week beschikbaar (32 uur is eventueel bespreekbaar)

  • Je bezit over hbo werk- en denkniveau

  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B en een auto (vereist voor periodieke klantbezoeken door heel het land)

  • Je hebt relevante werkervaring binnen recruitment, accountmanagement of de uitzendbranche

  • Je bezit over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, proactieve werkhouding en een natuurlijke drive om teams te coachen en processen te optimaliseren

Aan de slag!

Als Coördinator Recruitment Talent Center ben jij de onmisbare schakel tussen de recruiters, onze interne accountgroepen en grote landelijke opdrachtgevers zoals DPD en PostNL. Jij bent de rechterhand van de Recruitment Manager, aan wie je ook direct rapporteert. Samen vormen jullie de spil van de operatie! Jij bent het eerste aanspreekpunt op de vloer, bewaakt de voortgang van het gehele wervingsproces en zorgt ervoor dat de planningen vlekkeloos verlopen. In deze veelzijdige en uitdagende rol balanceer je moeiteloos tussen vijf kernrollen: Accountmanager, Werkgever, Poolmanager, Controller en Expert. Je neemt het voortouw tijdens dagstarts, analyseert resultaten, stopt de juiste energie in het coachen van recruiters en springt op drukke piekmomenten zelf actief bij in het recruitmentproces. Dit maakt jouw dag dynamisch, impactvol en vol variatie!

Dit ga je concreet doen:

  • Fungeren als de rechterhand van de Recruitment Manager en sparren over operationele en strategische doelstellingen;

  • Sturen op bezetting, wervingsresultaten, capaciteitsplanning en de structuur van het recruitmentproces;

  • Aansluiten bij en leiden van recruitmentcalls, dagstarts en performance meetings;

  • Verzorgen van de periodieke forecasting met de operationele accountspecialisten en het opstellen van managementrapportages;

  • Begeleiden, coachen en feedback geven aan recruiters om hun talent optimaal te ontwikkelen;

  • Proactief opbouwen en onderhouden van een robuuste kandidatenpool voor piek- en dalperiodes;

  • Optreden als sparringpartner en expert op het gebied van de arbeidsmarkt voor klanten en de interne organisatie;

  • Actief meewerken en recruiten tijdens piekmomenten om het team te ondersteunen.

Dit is jouw team!

Je komt te werken binnen de dynamische divisie Tempo-Team Performance Management (TTPM). Onze uitvalsbasis is het bruisende kantoor in Eindhoven (Anderlechtstraat), maar we werken voor landelijke accounts. Je werkt nauw samen met een enthousiast en gedreven team van recruiters en accountspecialisten. Als rechterhand van de Recruitment Manager / Operationeel Manager rapporteer je direct aan haar. Samen vormen jullie een hecht team waar hard werken en werkplezier hand in hand gaan. Dankzij onze hybride werkmogelijkheden en de afwisseling tussen kantoor, thuiswerken en incidentele klantbezoeken, is geen dag hetzelfde!

De kracht van Tempo-Team

Maak van je werk een plek waar je blij van wordt! Want als je dan toch een groot deel van je leven werkt, kun je het maar beter zo leuk mogelijk maken. We zijn een nuchtere club waar we eerlijk tegen elkaar zijn, maar ook samen successen vieren met een flinke dosis humor. Of het nu gaat om een vliegende start via ons StartUp programma of doorgroeien naar je volgende stap: bij ons sta je nooit stil. Jouw groei is onze groei, logisch toch? Hoppa, op naar de volgende match!

Grijp deze kans

Denk je nu: dit is mijn baan als Coördinator Recruitment Talent Center? Solliciteer direct! Waarom wachten als je ook nu de stap naar meer werkplezier kunt zetten? We maken het je niet te moeilijk: solliciteer via de website en laat van je horen. Heb je toch nog een brandende vraag voordat je op verzenden drukt? Onze Talent Acquisition Specialist Etelka Szatmari staat voor je klaar. Bel naar M +31 6 21 45 75 46 (WhatsApp kan ook) of stuur een mailtje naar etelka.szatmari@randstadgroep.nl.

title: Staff Engineer - Data and Backend Platforms
description:
Job Description:

About the Team

Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting‑edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.

About the Role:

As a Staff Data Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of scalable, reliable data platforms and pipelines that power analytics, product experiences, and business‑critical decision‑making. Balancing significant hands‑on development with technical leadership, you will shape engineering direction for the team, drive high‑impact cross‑team initiatives, and partner closely with engineering, product, analytics, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and improve departmental outcomes. You will be part of the Technology team.

You Will :

  • Lead & Architect: Deliver large‑scale data engineering initiatives with high quality and clear business impact by setting technical direction and influencing architecture decisions across data systems, storage, transformation, and serving layers.

  • Problem Solve & Optimize: Drive durable improvements in data quality, reliability, and maintainability by solving ambiguous challenges using structured approaches, identifying systemic issues, and anticipating obstacles.

  • Mentor & Collaborate: Establish trusted technical leadership and increase team effectiveness through mentorship, code reviews, and structured problem‑solving while building alignment across cross‑functional teams and executive audiences.

You Have:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in software or data engineering, with meaningful experience operating at staff scope.

  • Hands‑on experience with data lakes (Snowflake), modern data orchestration ( dbt, Airflow ).

  • Deep experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, Kinesis, ECS, SNS, SQS, Lambda, and related cloud infrastructure.

  • Very strong programming and query skills in SQL , Java (Spring Boot), and Python , along with experience designing REST APIs, GraphQL services, and managing relational and NoSQL databases in high‑scale systems.

  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and modern software delivery practices

  • Proven ability to lead complex, ambiguous technical initiatives, balancing hands‑on engineering with long‑term strategic direction while influencing decision‑making across business units.

  • Strong understanding of system design, platform engineering, software architecture, security, performance, and maintainability best practices for large‑scale data environments

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten tai soita Amikon Ilonalle p. 050 3589561 ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

title: EMS Technician - Philadelphia
description:
The EMS Technician is responsible for the installation, programming, troubleshooting, and maintenance of energy management systems across various commercial and industrial facilities, with a focus on refrigeration and HVAC systems. The successful candidate will ensure that EMS systems operate optimally, providing detailed monitoring and control over energy usage, and contributing to energy savings and sustainability goals. This position requires both technical expertise and the ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • EMS Installation and Commissioning: Install, configure, and commission energy management systems (EMS) and related hardware components for refrigeration, HVAC, and lighting systems.
  • Troubleshooting and Repair: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair EMS hardware and software issues, ensuring minimal downtime of energy systems.
  • System Programming and Monitoring: Program and configure EMS to optimize energy usage based on operational needs and energy-saving goals. Ensure the systems are functioning correctly and respond to any alarms or irregularities in real time.
  • Preventive Maintenance: Perform regular preventive maintenance on EMS hardware and software to prevent system failures and ensure optimal performance.
  • Energy Usage Reporting: Monitor energy usage data, generate reports, and analyze trends. Provide insights into potential energy-saving opportunities and system performance improvements.
  • Client Communication and Support: Work directly with customers to understand their needs, provide technical support, and ensure EMS systems meet their energy management goals. Provide training on EMS operation when necessary.
  • Compliance and Safety: Ensure all work complies with company policies, industry standards, and safety regulations. Stay updated on relevant codes, regulations, and best practices in energy management and sustainability.
  • Collaboration with Teams: Collaborate with engineering, project management, and field service teams to ensure seamless EMS integration with other building systems, particularly HVAC and refrigeration.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate records of EMS installations, service activities, and repair logs. Provide detailed reports on system performance and maintenance activities.
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Skills, Education, and Competencies

  • Associate's degree in electrical engineering, HVAC technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience working with energy management systems, refrigeration, HVAC systems, or similar technologies.
  • Hands-on experience in EMS installation, programming, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems, controls, and EMS technology.
  • Proficiency in using EMS software and remote monitoring tools.
  • Familiarity with HVAC and refrigeration systems and their energy consumption patterns.
  • Knowledge of energy conservation practices and sustainability principles.
  • EPA 608 certification or equivalent.
  • EMS-related certifications (e.g., Schneider Electric, Honeywell, or Siemens EMS platforms).
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication skills for working with customers and team members.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and prioritize work effectively.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites for installation, service, and maintenance work.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

The physical demands and work environment characteristics are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the job's essential functions. Variable and flexible hours that require periods of "on-call" status. While performing the duties of this job.

  • The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, crawl, climb, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, talk, hear, and lift/push/pull up to 75lbs.
  • The employee is frequently required to communicate by telephone, read regular and small print, and view and prepare documents.
  • Must be able to work in a variety of weather conditions and terrains.
  • The noise level in the work environment varies from quiet to loud due to machinery and other factors on the job site.
  • Due to the nature of the commercial refrigeration and construction projects, there may be some exposure to chemical and hazardous materials.

title: Legal Intern
description:
The Opportunity

The Legal Intern will participate in a structured learning experience within the Firm's Family Law or Immigration Law practice while gaining practical exposure to the day-to-day operations of a law firm. Under the direction and supervision of Attorneys and other legal team members, the intern will observe and assist with legal and case-related activities designed to develop professional communication, legal research, organization, judgment, and other practical legal skills. The internship is generally expected to involve approximately 20 hours per week, with scheduling designed to accommodate academic commitments.


Learning Activities & Responsibilities

  • Assist Attorneys and legal team members with supervised case-related projects and assignments.
  • Conduct basic legal and factual research and summarize findings for the legal team.
  • Assist with preparing, proofreading, formatting, and organizing legal documents and correspondence.
  • Assist with reviewing and organizing case files, records, exhibits, discovery, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with preparing hearing, mediation, trial, and other case-preparation materials.
  • Review documents and case information for completeness, organization, and basic inconsistencies.
  • Observe client meetings, consultations, hearings, and other legal proceedings when appropriate and authorized.
  • Gain exposure to case management, Firm workflows, professional standards, client service, and legal-office procedures.
  • Participate in Firm and team meetings, training sessions, and case discussions when appropriate.
  • Assist with supervised case-related and administrative projects that support the intern's learning and professional development.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and exercise professionalism when handling client and Firm information.

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in an accredited law school, college, or university. Law students are preferred, although undergraduate students with a demonstrated interest in law or the legal profession will also be considered.
  • Students seeking academic credit must provide the Firm with any applicable requirements or documentation from their educational institution.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, organizational skills, and attention to detail.
  • Dependable, punctual, professional, and accountable, with the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Ability to follow instructions, accept constructive feedback, apply what is learned, and ask questions when clarification is needed.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and exercise appropriate judgment when handling sensitive information.

Key Success Factors

  • Consistently arrives prepared and on time, completes assignments as expected, and communicates promptly regarding questions or obstacles.
  • Completes assigned work carefully and accurately and reviews work before submitting it.
  • Demonstrates curiosity, asks appropriate questions, accepts feedback professionally, and applies feedback to future assignments.
  • Exercises sound judgment, maintains confidentiality, and interacts professionally with clients, coworkers, and others.
  • Demonstrates active engagement in the learning experience by asking thoughtful questions, seeking feedback, applying instruction, and showing progressive development throughout the internship.


Internship Structure

This is an unpaid educational internship designed to provide practical exposure to the legal profession and law firm operations, and there is no expectation of compensation for participation. The internship will include supervised assignments, observation, training, and feedback intended to support the intern's professional development. The Firm will work with interns seeking academic credit to accommodate applicable educational institution requirements, including reasonable documentation or evaluation requirements. The internship is for a defined period and does not create an expectation or guarantee of paid employment upon completion.

PastryStar, a manufacturer of premium bakery ingredients, is seeking a hands-on and organized Sanitation Lead to oversee and perform sanitation duties across our food production facility. This includes cleaning of equipment, production zones, and facility common areas, while supervising sanitation staff and ensuring compliance with food safety and hygiene standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the sanitation team in the cleaning and sanitizing of mixers, blenders, kettles, depositors, conveyors, tools, utensils, packaging lines, and all food-contact surfaces in accordance with the Master Sanitation Schedule.
  • Ensure allergen changeovers and sanitation procedures are followed rigorously to prevent cross-contamination (e.g., between dairy, nuts, gluten-free, etc.).
  • Perform and supervise cleaning of dry mix and liquid production zones, including equipment teardown and reassembly after sanitation.
  • Oversee the sanitation of tanks, totes, and filling lines used for pastry creams, glazes, and other high-viscosity products.
  • Ensure that floor drains, walls, ceilings, racks, pallets, and shelving in production and warehouse areas are routinely cleaned to prevent pest or mold issues.
  • Ensure proper handling and safe use of cleaning chemicals used in a food manufacturing environment; maintain accurate SDS records.
  • Conduct and document pre-op inspections before shift start to ensure areas are clean and production-ready.
  • Train sanitation team members on GMPs, proper hygiene, PPE usage, and sanitation procedures specific to PastryStar’s product types and processes.
  • Monitor sanitation records for accuracy and completeness; escalate any missed or incomplete tasks to management.
  • Communicate effectively with Production, QA, and Maintenance to coordinate cleaning schedules, equipment access, and support for audits or shutdown cleanings.
  • Assist in preparing for and supporting third-party food safety audits, customer inspections, and internal quality assessments.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Minimum 5-10 years of sanitation experience in a food manufacturing environment
  • Prior experience in a lead or supervisory role preferred
  • Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs)
  • Food safety standards (FDA, FSMA)
  • Allergen control procedures
  • Cleaning and sanitation chemicals, tools, and Safety Data Sheets (SDS)
  • Food production equipment (mixers, kettles, tanks, blenders, etc.)
  • Dry mix and liquid production areas
  • Common areas such as restrooms, breakrooms, and kitchens
  • Ability to follow Master Sanitation Schedules and complete sanitation logs accurately
  • Strong attention to detail and time management skills
  • Ability to train and lead a small sanitation team
  • Good communication skills; bilingual (Spanish/English) is a plus
  • Lift up to 50 lbs
  • Computer skills
  • Stand, bend, and climb for long periods
  • Work in wet, humid, or temperature-controlled environments
  • Willingness to wear required PPE at all times (gloves, goggles, boots, etc.)

PastryStar is proud to provide a clean, safe, and quality-driven environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and value teamwork, food safety, and operational excellence.

title: Senior Director of Multi Channel Buying
description:
SKIMS is a solutions-oriented brand creating the next generation of underwear, loungewear, shapewear, and essentials. We are setting new standards by delivering technically innovative, comfort-driven products with elevated design for everybody.

At the intersection of culture, innovation, and commerce, SKIMS is a global brand redefining modern apparel. Our teams are built on creativity, collaboration, and operational excellence, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance environment where ambitious, curious, and values-driven individuals can do the best work of their careers.

As we continue to scale globally, our HQ teams play a critical role in shaping strategy, building world-class infrastructure, and driving sustainable growth across markets.

Position Summary

The Senior Director of Multi-Channel Buying is responsible for leading the commercial buying strategy across SKIMS' owned retail stores and digital channels, ensuring assortments maximize customer demand, inventory productivity, and profitable growth. This leader will develop and execute buying strategies that deliver a seamless omnichannel customer experience while supporting new product launches, seasonal initiatives, and global expansion.

Reporting into executive leadership, this role partners closely with Planning, Product Merchandising, Design, Retail Operations, Digital, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure the right product is available in the right place, at the right time, while maintaining the integrity of the SKIMS brand. This individual is highly analytical, commercially minded, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where agility and collaboration are essential.



Multi-Channel Buying Strategy
  • Lead the buying strategy across owned retail and digital channels, ensuring assortments are optimized for each customer touchpoint while maintaining a cohesive brand experience.
  • Develop seasonal and long-range buying strategies aligned with category growth plans, financial objectives, and business priorities.
  • Build balanced assortments across core, fashion, and innovation, supported by customer insights, historical performance, and emerging trends.
  • Drive assortment segmentation by channel, region, customer behavior, and store clustering to maximize productivity and customer relevance.
  • Partner closely with Global Merchandising and Digital teams to support product launches and capitalize on omnichannel opportunities.

Commercial Performance & Inventory Management
  • Own channel-level sales performance, gross margin, inventory productivity, and sell-through metrics.
  • Partner with Planning to develop Open-to-Buy strategies, receipt flow, inventory depth, and replenishment plans.
  • Analyze weekly business performance and react quickly to changing customer demand through in-season buying decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize inventory placement across channels while minimizing markdown exposure.
  • Lead exit strategies and inventory risk management while protecting brand integrity.
Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Partner with Product Development and Merchandising to influence future assortments based on customer insights and business performance.
  • Collaborate with Retail Operations to ensure assortments support operational excellence and elevate the in-store customer experience.
  • Work closely with Marketing and Visual Merchandising to support product launches, seasonal campaigns, and key commercial moments.
  • Partner with Supply Chain to ensure buying strategies are operationally executable and scalable across a growing global business.
  • Collaborate with Wholesale and Ecommerce leaders to ensure a cohesive omnichannel product strategy.
Global Growth & Expansion
  • Support new store openings with localized assortment and inventory strategies.
  • Develop regional buying frameworks that balance local customer preferences with global brand consistency.
  • Continuously refine channel strategies as SKIMS expands into new markets and retail formats.


Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of buyers across multiple product categories.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish clear priorities, decision-making frameworks, and performance expectations across the buying organization.
  • Champion data-driven decision-making while encouraging entrepreneurial thinking and innovation.
  • 10+ years of buying or merchandising experience within a high-growth fashion, apparel, or consumer brand, including significant leadership experience at the Director or Senior Director level.
  • Proven success leading buying strategies across multiple sales channels, including owned retail and ecommerce.
  • Deep understanding of apparel buying, assortment planning, inventory management, and commercial retail performance.
  • Strong analytical capabilities with experience managing large inventory investments and Open-to-Buy strategies.
  • Exceptional ability to interpret customer behavior, market trends, and business performance to inform buying decisions.
  • Experience supporting rapid retail expansion and international growth preferred.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Product, Planning, Operations, Marketing, and Supply Chain.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Why This Role Matters

The Senior Director of Multi-Channel Buying plays a pivotal role in shaping how customers experience SKIMS across every shopping channel. By combining commercial expertise, customer insight, and strategic thinking, this leader will ensure our assortments drive growth, maximize profitability, and deliver a consistent, elevated brand experience as SKIMS continues its global expansion.
